## 342. CSS ДЛЯ PRICING TABLES

```css
/* ─── Pricing Container ─── */
.pricing-section {
  padding: var(--s-16) var(--s-4);
}

.pricing-toggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-10);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}

.pricing-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-5);
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  align-items: start;
}

/* ─── Pricing Card ─── */
.price-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-3xl);
  padding: var(--s-8) var(--s-7);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-5);
  position: relative;
}

/* Featured plan */
.price-card.featured {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  scale: 1.04;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 48px oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.3);
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Popular badge */
.price-card.featured::before {
  content: 'ПОПУЛЯРНЫЙ';
  position: absolute;
  top: -14px;
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  background: var(--c-warning);
  color: oklch(15% 0 0);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  padding: 4px var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.price-name {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.price-amount {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  line-height: 1;
}

.price-currency {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  padding-top: 6px;
}

.price-number {
  font-size: var(--text-6xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.price-period {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  padding-top: 12px;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.price-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  opacity: 0.7;
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
}

/* Features list */
.price-features {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  flex: 1;
}

.price-feature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--s-2-5);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
}

.feature-check {
  width: 18px; height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-success);
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
}

.price-card.featured .feature-check {
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 30%);
}

.feature-missing {
  opacity: 0.4;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

.feature-missing .feature-check {
  background: var(--c-border);
  color: transparent;
}

/* CTA */
.price-cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-6);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: background 0.15s, scale 0.1s;
  text-decoration: none;

  &:active { scale: 0.98; }
}

.price-card:not(.featured) .price-cta {
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  &:hover { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
}

.price-card.featured .price-cta {
  background: white;
  color: var(--c-accent);
  &:hover { background: oklch(95% 0 0); }
}

/* Comparison table */
.comparison-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin-top: var(--s-12);
}

.comparison-table th,
.comparison-table td {
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  text-align: center;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.comparison-table th:first-child,
.comparison-table td:first-child {
  text-align: start;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}

.comparison-table .feature-row:nth-child(even) { background: var(--c-muted); }
.comparison-table .plan-header { background: var(--c-muted); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); }

.check-yes { color: var(--c-success); font-size: 1.2em; }
.check-no  { color: var(--c-border);  font-size: 1.2em; }
```

## 343. CSS ДЛЯ IMAGE GALLERY И LIGHTBOX

```css
/* ─── Masonry Photo Gallery ─── */
.photo-gallery {
  column-count: 3;
  column-gap: var(--s-3);

  @media (width < 768px) { column-count: 2; }
  @media (width < 480px) { column-count: 1; }
}

@supports (grid-template-rows: masonry) {
  .photo-gallery {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: masonry;
    column-count: initial;
    gap: var(--s-3);
  }
}

.photo-item {
  break-inside: avoid;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;

  @supports (grid-template-rows: masonry) { margin-bottom: 0; }
}

.photo-item img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  transition: scale 0.4s ease;
}

/* Overlay on hover */
.photo-item::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 40%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.photo-item:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
.photo-item:hover img    { scale: 1.04; }

/* Zoom icon */
.photo-item::before {
  content: '⌕';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% -50%;
  font-size: 2rem;
  color: white;
  z-index: 1;
  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0.5;
  transition: opacity 0.3s, scale 0.3s;
}

.photo-item:hover::before { opacity: 1; scale: 1; }

/* ─── Lightbox ─── */
.lightbox {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-modal);
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 95%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--s-8);

  /* Анимация */
  opacity: 0;
  display: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.lightbox.open {
  display: flex;
  opacity: 1;
}

@starting-style {
  .lightbox.open { opacity: 0; }
}

.lightbox-image {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  animation: lightbox-zoom 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes lightbox-zoom {
  from { scale: 0.9; opacity: 0; }
}

.lightbox-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-4); right: var(--s-4);
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 15%);
  border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 20%);
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 25%); }
}

.lightbox-nav {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  width: 48px; height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 15%);
  border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 20%);
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 25%); }
}

.lightbox-prev { left: var(--s-4); }
.lightbox-next { right: var(--s-4); }

.lightbox-counter {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--s-4);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 70%);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

/* ─── Grid Gallery (uniform grid) ─── */
.grid-gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 2px;
}

.grid-gallery-item {
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.grid-gallery-item img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: scale 0.4s ease, filter 0.4s;
}

.grid-gallery-item:hover img { scale: 1.08; filter: brightness(0.85); }

/* Featured layout (первое фото большое) */
.gallery-featured {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 300px 200px;
  gap: 2px;
}

.gallery-featured .main { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / 3; }
```

## 344. CSS ДЛЯ СТАТУС-СТРАНИЦ И СИСТЕМНЫХ UI

```css
/* ─── Status Page ─── */
.status-header {
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--s-12) var(--s-4);
}

.status-indicator {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-6);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
}

.status-indicator.operational {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-success) l c h / 0.12);
  color: var(--c-success);
}

.status-indicator.degraded {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-warning) l c h / 0.12);
  color: var(--c-warning);
}

.status-indicator.outage {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.12);
  color: var(--c-danger);
}

/* Animated dot */
.status-dot {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
  position: relative;
}

.status-indicator.operational .status-dot::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.3;
  animation: status-pulse 2s ease-out infinite;
}

@keyframes status-pulse {
  0%   { scale: 1; opacity: 0.3; }
  100% { scale: 2; opacity: 0; }
}

/* ─── Uptime History Bars ─── */
.uptime-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--s-6) var(--s-8);
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-6);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
}

.uptime-name { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); font-size: var(--text-sm); }

.uptime-bars {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
  align-items: flex-end;
  height: 32px;
}

.uptime-bar {
  flex: 1;
  border-radius: 2px;
  height: 100%;
  min-width: 3px;
  background: var(--c-success);
  transition: opacity 0.1s;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
}

.uptime-bar.incident      { background: var(--c-danger); }
.uptime-bar.degraded      { background: var(--c-warning); }
.uptime-bar.no-data       { background: var(--c-border); }

.uptime-bar:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

/* Tooltip on hover */
.uptime-bar:hover::after {
  content: attr(data-date) ' — ' attr(data-status);
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + 6px);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  background: var(--c-text);
  color: var(--c-bg);
  padding: 3px var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font-size: 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  z-index: 10;
}

.uptime-percent {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-success);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ─── Incident Timeline ─── */
.incident-item {
  padding: var(--s-5);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) 0;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
}

.incident-item.resolved   { border-left-color: var(--c-success); }
.incident-item.monitoring { border-left-color: var(--c-warning); }
.incident-item.identified { border-left-color: var(--c-danger); }

.incident-title { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); margin-bottom: var(--s-2); }

.incident-update {
  padding: var(--s-3) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.update-time { color: var(--c-text-muted); white-space: nowrap; }

/* ─── System Metrics ─── */
.metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.metric-card {
  padding: var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  text-align: center;
}

.metric-value {
  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-1);
}

.metric-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
}

.metric-card.good   .metric-value { color: var(--c-success); }
.metric-card.warn   .metric-value { color: var(--c-warning); }
.metric-card.danger .metric-value { color: var(--c-danger); }
```

## 345. CSS ДЛЯ CODE BROWSER И FILE MANAGER

```css
/* ─── File Manager Layout ─── */
.file-manager {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.fm-toolbar {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.fm-sidebar {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-2);
}

.fm-content {
  overflow: auto;
  padding: var(--s-4);
}

/* ─── File Tree ─── */
.tree-node {
  user-select: none;
}

.tree-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text);
  transition: background 0.1s;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.active { background: var(--c-accent-sub); color: var(--c-accent); }
  &.selected { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

.tree-toggle {
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: rotate 0.15s;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
}

.tree-node.expanded > .tree-item .tree-toggle { rotate: 90deg; }

.tree-icon {
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Icon colors by type */
.icon-folder  { color: oklch(75% 0.20 85); }
.icon-js      { color: oklch(75% 0.20 85); }
.icon-ts      { color: oklch(60% 0.22 230); }
.icon-css     { color: oklch(60% 0.22 260); }
.icon-html    { color: oklch(60% 0.22 30); }
.icon-json    { color: oklch(60% 0.18 145); }
.icon-md      { color: oklch(50% 0 0); }
.icon-img     { color: oklch(65% 0.20 300); }

.tree-children {
  padding-left: var(--s-4);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  margin-left: var(--s-3);
}

/* ─── File Grid View ─── */
.file-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(100px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

.file-thumb {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  text-align: center;

  &:hover   { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.selected { background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
}

.file-thumb-icon {
  width: 56px; height: 56px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
}

.file-thumb-name {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ─── Breadcrumb path ─── */
.path-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.path-segment {
  padding: var(--s-1) var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
  &:last-child { color: var(--c-text); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
}

.path-sep { color: var(--c-border); }

/* ─── Code Block with Line Numbers ─── */
.code-viewer {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: 1.7;
  overflow: auto;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-4) 0;
  counter-reset: line;
}

.code-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 0 var(--s-4);
  counter-increment: line;
  min-height: 1.7em;
  transition: background 0.1s;
}

.code-line:hover { background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.05); }
.code-line.highlighted { background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.12); }

.code-line::before {
  content: counter(line);
  min-width: 3ch;
  margin-right: var(--s-5);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  opacity: 0.5;
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  user-select: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.code-content { flex: 1; }
```

## 346. CSS ФИНАЛЬНЫЕ PATTERN SNIPPETS

```css
/* ─── 20 последних незаменимых CSS паттернов ─── */

/* 1. Квадратная аватарка с фолбеком на инициалы */
.avatar {
  width: var(--sz, 40px); height: var(--sz, 40px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: calc(var(--sz, 40px) * 0.4);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  user-select: none;
}

.avatar img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }

/* 2. Divider с текстом */
.divider {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.divider::before, .divider::after { content:''; flex:1; height:1px; background:var(--c-border); }

/* 3. Visually rich separator */
.fancy-hr {
  border: none;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--c-accent), transparent);
  margin-block: var(--s-8);
}

/* 4. Цветной акцент-бар слева */
.accent-left {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--c-accent);
  padding-left: var(--s-4);
  border-radius: 0 var(--r-md) var(--r-md) 0;
}

/* 5. Sticky bottom CTA */
.sticky-cta {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  padding: var(--s-4);
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--c-bg) 70%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

/* 6. Number counter (large display) */
.big-number {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+30)));
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

/* 7. Pull quote */
.pull-quote {
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  color: var(--c-text);
  text-wrap: balance;
  padding: var(--s-6) var(--s-8);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--c-accent);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--c-accent);
  margin-block: var(--s-8);
  position: relative;
}

.pull-quote::before {
  content: '"';
  font-size: 6rem;
  line-height: 0.8;
  color: var(--c-accent);
  opacity: 0.3;
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-2);
  left: var(--s-4);
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
}

/* 8. Tag cloud */
.tag-cloud {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  align-items: center;
}

.tag {
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;
  cursor: pointer;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-accent-sub); color: var(--c-accent); }
  &.active { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
}

/* 9. Social share buttons */
.share-btns { display: flex; gap: var(--s-2); }
.share-btn {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: white;
  border: none; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  transition: scale 0.15s, filter 0.15s;

  &:hover { scale: 1.1; filter: brightness(1.1); }
}

.share-twitter  { background: oklch(60% 0.22 220); }
.share-facebook { background: oklch(45% 0.22 250); }
.share-linkedin { background: oklch(45% 0.20 230); }
.share-copy     { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }

/* 10. Floating label animation (альтернатива) */
.field-float-simple {
  position: relative;
  padding-top: var(--s-3);
}

.field-float-simple label {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-5);
  left: var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  transform-origin: left top;
}

.field-float-simple input:focus ~ label,
.field-float-simple input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label {
  translate: 0 -22px;
  scale: 0.8;
  color: var(--c-accent);
}

/* 11. Cookie banner */
.cookie-banner {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--s-4);
  left: var(--s-4);
  right: var(--s-4);
  max-width: 480px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-5);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  z-index: var(--z-toast);
  animation: slide-from-bottom 0.4s var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes slide-from-bottom {
  from { translate: 0 100%; opacity: 0; }
}

/* 12. Back to top button */
.back-to-top {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--s-6);
  right: var(--s-6);
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-lg);
  transition: scale 0.2s, opacity 0.3s, translate 0.3s;
  opacity: 0;
  translate: 0 16px;
  pointer-events: none;

  &.visible { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; pointer-events: auto; }
  &:hover   { scale: 1.1; }
}

/* 13. Reading time indicator */
.reading-time {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}

/* 14. Code с copy кнопкой */
.code-block {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.code-block pre { padding: var(--s-5); overflow-x: auto; }

.code-copy {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-3); right: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.code-block:hover .code-copy { opacity: 1; }
.code-copy.copied { color: var(--c-success); border-color: var(--c-success); }

/* 15. Notification dot на иконке */
.with-badge {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
}

.with-badge .badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px; right: -4px;
  min-width: 16px; height: 16px;
  background: var(--c-danger);
  color: white;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 4px;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-bg);
}

/* 16. Gradient text highlight */
.text-highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, oklch(90% 0.15 85) 0%, oklch(90% 0.15 85) 100%);
  background-size: 100% 40%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: 0 85%;
}

/* 17. Marquee (infinite scroll text) */
.marquee { overflow: hidden; display: flex; }
.marquee-track {
  display: flex; gap: var(--s-6); white-space: nowrap;
  animation: marquee-scroll 20s linear infinite;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.marquee:hover .marquee-track { animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes marquee-scroll { to { translate: -50% 0; } }

/* 18. Gradient border on input focus */
.gradient-focus-input {
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  background:
    var(--c-surface) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+30))) border-box;

  &:focus { outline: none; }
}

/* 19. Step progress bar */
.step-progress {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
}

.step-segment {
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;

  &:first-child { border-radius: var(--r-full) 0 0 var(--r-full); }
  &:last-child  { border-radius: 0 var(--r-full) var(--r-full) 0; }
  & + & { margin-left: 2px; }
}

.step-segment.done::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: var(--c-accent);
}

.step-segment.active::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  width: var(--progress, 50%);
  transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

/* 20. Emoji reaction buttons */
.reactions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

.reaction {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: var(--s-1) var(--s-2-5);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s, border-color 0.1s, scale 0.1s;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-accent-sub); border-color: var(--c-accent); }
  &.active { background: var(--c-accent-sub); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: var(--c-accent); }
  &:active { scale: 0.95; }
}

.reaction .count {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
```

## 348. CSS СОЦИАЛЬНЫЕ ЛЕНТЫ — FEED И TIMELINE

```css
/* ─── Social Feed Layout ─── */
.social-feed {
  max-width: 600px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-4);
}

/* ─── Post Card ─── */
.post {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.post:hover { box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }

.post-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-4);
}

.post-avatar {
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: cover;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
}

.post-meta { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.post-author {
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.post-time {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.post-menu {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

/* Post body */
.post-body {
  padding: 0 var(--s-4) var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
}

/* Expand long posts */
.post-body.collapsed {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 5;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.post-expand {
  color: var(--c-accent);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  font: inherit;
}

/* Post media */
.post-media {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.post-media img, .post-media video {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* Multi-image grid */
.post-media-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.post-media-grid.count-2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.post-media-grid.count-3 {
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
}
.post-media-grid.count-3 .item-0 { grid-row: 1 / 3; }
.post-media-grid.count-4 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; }

.post-media-grid .media-item {
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  position: relative;
}

.post-media-grid .media-item img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* +N overlay для 5+ фото */
.media-more-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 60%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: white;
}

/* Link preview */
.post-link-preview {
  margin: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

.link-preview-image {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.link-preview-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.link-preview-info {
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
}

.link-preview-domain {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.link-preview-title {
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin-block: var(--s-1);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Post actions */
.post-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.post-action {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
}

.post-action.liked {
  color: oklch(60% 0.22 15);
  .post-action-icon { animation: heart-pop 0.4s var(--ease-spring); }
}

@keyframes heart-pop {
  0% { scale: 1; }
  50% { scale: 1.4; }
  100% { scale: 1; }
}

.post-action.reposted { color: var(--c-success); }
.post-action.bookmarked { color: var(--c-accent); }

/* Comments section */
.post-comments {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.comment {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2-5);
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.comment-bubble {
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  flex: 1;
}

.comment-author {
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-1);
}

.comment-text { font-size: var(--text-sm); }
```

## 349. CSS ДЛЯ ВИДЕО ПЛЕЕРА

```css
/* ─── Video Player Container ─── */
.video-player {
  position: relative;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}

.video-player video {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

/* ─── Controls overlay ─── */
.video-controls {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4) var(--s-4);
  background: linear-gradient(to top, oklch(0% 0 0 / 80%), transparent);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.video-player:hover .video-controls,
.video-player.paused .video-controls,
.video-player.controls-visible .video-controls {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Progress bar */
.video-progress {
  position: relative;
  height: 4px;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 30%);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: height 0.15s;
}

.video-player:hover .video-progress { height: 6px; }

.video-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.video-progress-buffered {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 20%);
  border-radius: inherit;
}

.video-progress-thumb {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  translate: -50% -50%;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-sm);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.video-player:hover .video-progress-thumb { opacity: 1; }

/* Control buttons row */
.video-btns {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.video-btn {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s, scale 0.1s;
  font-size: 1.1rem;

  &:hover { background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 15%); }
  &:active { scale: 0.9; }
}

.video-btn-play { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 1.4rem; }

.video-time {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: white;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-inline: var(--s-2);
}

.video-spacer { flex: 1; }

/* Volume control */
.video-volume {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.volume-slider {
  width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: width 0.2s;
}

.video-volume:hover .volume-slider,
.video-volume:focus-within .volume-slider {
  width: 80px;
}

.volume-slider input {
  width: 80px;
  accent-color: var(--c-accent);
  height: 3px;
}

/* Fullscreen mode */
.video-player:fullscreen,
.video-player:-webkit-full-screen {
  border-radius: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  aspect-ratio: unset;
}

/* Loading spinner overlay */
.video-spinner {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 20%);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

.video-player.loading .video-spinner { opacity: 1; }

/* Big play button */
.video-play-big {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% -50%;
  width: 72px; height: 72px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 60%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border: 2px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 50%);
  color: white;
  font-size: 2rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0.8;
  transition: opacity 0.3s, scale 0.3s;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.video-player.paused .video-play-big {
  opacity: 1;
  scale: 1;
}
```

## 350. CSS ДЛЯ ПУСТЫХ СОСТОЯНИЙ И ОШИБОК

```css
/* ─── Empty State ─── */
.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--s-16) var(--s-8);
  gap: var(--s-4);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  min-height: 300px;
}

.empty-icon {
  width: 80px; height: 80px;
  border-radius: var(--r-3xl);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-2);
}

.empty-title {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-text);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.empty-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  max-width: 40ch;
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* Варианты empty state */
.empty-state-search .empty-icon { background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
.empty-state-error  .empty-icon { background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.1); }

/* ─── 404 Error Page ─── */
.error-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--s-8);
  gap: var(--s-6);
}

.error-code {
  font-size: clamp(6rem, 20vw, 12rem);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+40)));
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  /* Subtle noise */
  position: relative;
}

.error-title {
  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.error-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  max-width: 50ch;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.error-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Animated 404 illustration */
.error-illustration {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
}

.error-illustration .orbit-dot {
  position: absolute;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  animation: orbit-404 3s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes orbit-404 {
  from { rotate: 0deg; translate: 80px 0; }
  to   { rotate: 360deg; translate: 80px 0; }
}

/* ─── 500 Server Error ─── */
.error-500 .error-code { 
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-danger), oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c calc(h+30)));
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
}

/* ─── Network Error ─── */
.offline-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--s-8);
  gap: var(--s-5);
}

.offline-icon {
  font-size: 5rem;
  animation: offline-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes offline-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50%       { opacity: 0.5; }
}

/* ─── Permission Denied ─── */
.access-denied {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--c-danger);
  padding: var(--s-6);
  background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.05);
  border-radius: 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) 0;
}

/* ─── Loading Error (retry) ─── */
.load-error {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-8);
  text-align: center;
}

.retry-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-5);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-border); }
}

.retry-icon {
  animation: none;
  transition: rotate 0.3s;
}

.retry-btn:hover .retry-icon { rotate: 360deg; }
```

## 351. CSS ДЛЯ ПОИСКА И РЕЗУЛЬТАТОВ

```css
/* ─── Search Bar ─── */
.search-bar {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--s-3);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 18px; height: 18px;
}

.search-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3) var(--s-2-5) calc(var(--s-3) * 2 + 18px);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text);
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, width 0.3s ease;

  &:focus {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-accent-sub);
  }

  &::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}

/* Expanding search */
.search-expand .search-input {
  width: 48px;
  padding-inline: var(--s-2-5);

  &:focus {
    width: 280px;
    padding-inline-start: calc(var(--s-3) * 2 + 18px);
  }
}

/* Clear button */
.search-clear {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--s-3);
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: var(--c-text-muted);
  color: var(--c-bg);
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-text); }
}

.search-input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .search-clear { display: flex; }

/* ─── Search Suggestions Dropdown ─── */
.search-suggestions {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + var(--s-1));
  left: 0; right: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: var(--z-drop);
  max-height: 400px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.suggestion-group-label {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4) var(--s-1);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.suggestion-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover, &[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

.suggestion-icon {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.suggestion-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.suggestion-main {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Highlight matching text */
.suggestion-main mark {
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
}

.suggestion-sub {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* ─── Search Results Page ─── */
.search-results {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: var(--s-6) var(--s-4);
}

.search-results-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--s-5);
}

.results-count {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-1);
}

/* Filter chips */
.search-filters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-5);
}

.filter-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.1s;

  &.active { background: var(--c-accent-sub); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: var(--c-accent); }
  &:hover  { border-color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}

/* Result item */
.result-item {
  padding: var(--s-4) 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);

  &:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
}

.result-thumbnail {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 80px; height: 80px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.result-thumbnail img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.result-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.result-category {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-1);
}

.result-title {
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-1);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;

  &:hover { color: var(--c-accent); text-decoration: underline; }
}

.result-url {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-success);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-2);
}

.result-snippet {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.result-snippet mark {
  background: oklch(90% 0.18 85 / 40%);
  color: var(--c-text);
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}
```

## 352. CSS ДЛЯ USER PROFILE СТРАНИЦ

```css
/* ─── Profile Header ─── */
.profile-cover {
  height: 200px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+40)));
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl) 0 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.profile-cover img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.profile-header-actions {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-4); right: var(--s-4);
  display: flex; gap: var(--s-2);
}

.profile-info {
  padding: 0 var(--s-6) var(--s-6);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-top: none;
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl);
}

.profile-avatar-wrap {
  margin-top: calc(-1 * 50px);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.profile-avatar {
  width: 100px; height: 100px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 4px solid var(--c-surface);
  object-fit: cover;
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.profile-name {
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.profile-handle {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-0-5);
}

.profile-bio {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  margin-block: var(--s-3);
  max-width: 60ch;
}

/* Profile stats */
.profile-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-6);
  margin-top: var(--s-4);
}

.stat-item { text-align: center; }

.stat-value {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-0-5);
}

/* Profile metadata */
.profile-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-3) var(--s-5);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-3);
}

.meta-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

/* Social links */
.profile-socials {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  margin-top: var(--s-4);
}

/* Profile tabs content */
.profile-tabs-content {
  margin-top: var(--s-6);
}

/* Activity grid (GitHub-style) */
.activity-grid {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
}

.activity-week {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}

.activity-day {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: scale 0.1s;

  &:hover { scale: 1.3; }
}

/* Activity levels */
.activity-day[data-level="1"] { background: oklch(from var(--c-success) 87% 0.05 h); }
.activity-day[data-level="2"] { background: oklch(from var(--c-success) 75% 0.10 h); }
.activity-day[data-level="3"] { background: oklch(from var(--c-success) 60% 0.15 h); }
.activity-day[data-level="4"] { background: var(--c-success); }
```

## 353. CSS ДЛЯ SETTINGS СТРАНИЦ

```css
/* ─── Settings Layout ─── */
.settings-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-8);
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: var(--s-8) var(--s-4);
  align-items: start;
}

@media (width < 768px) {
  .settings-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* Settings Sidebar Nav */
.settings-nav {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.settings-nav-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2-5);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: start;
  font: inherit;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
  &.active {
    background: var(--c-accent-sub);
    color: var(--c-accent);
    font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  }
}

/* Settings Sections */
.settings-section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-6);
}

.settings-block {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.settings-block-header {
  padding: var(--s-5) var(--s-6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.settings-block-title {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
}

.settings-block-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-0-5);
}

/* Settings Row */
.settings-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  &:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
}

.settings-row-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.settings-row-label {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}

.settings-row-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.settings-row-control { flex-shrink: 0; }

/* Danger zone */
.settings-block.danger {
  border-color: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.3);
}

.settings-block.danger .settings-block-header {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.05);
}

.settings-block.danger .settings-block-title {
  color: var(--c-danger);
}

/* ─── Preferences Grid ─── */
.preferences-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-6);
}

.pref-card {
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);

  &:hover { border-color: var(--c-accent); background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
  &.selected {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  }
}

.pref-icon { font-size: 2rem; }
.pref-label { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }

/* Theme selector */
.theme-selector {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.theme-option {
  flex: 1;
  padding: var(--s-3);
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
  transition: border-color 0.1s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);

  &.selected { border-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.theme-preview {
  width: 100%; height: 60px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.theme-preview-top { flex: 0 0 20px; }
.theme-preview-body { flex: 1; }

.theme-light .theme-preview-top  { background: oklch(95% 0 0); }
.theme-light .theme-preview-body { background: oklch(100% 0 0); }
.theme-dark  .theme-preview-top  { background: oklch(15% 0 0); }
.theme-dark  .theme-preview-body { background: oklch(10% 0 0); }
.theme-auto  .theme-preview-top  { background: linear-gradient(to right, oklch(15% 0 0) 50%, oklch(95% 0 0) 50%); }
.theme-auto  .theme-preview-body { background: linear-gradient(to right, oklch(10% 0 0) 50%, oklch(100% 0 0) 50%); }
```

## 354. CSS ДЛЯ LANDING PAGES

```css
/* ─── Hero Section ─── */
.lp-hero {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-6);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lp-hero-content {
  max-width: 700px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.lp-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-5);
}

.lp-headline {
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  text-wrap: balance;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-5);
}

.lp-headline .highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+30)));
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

.lp-subtitle {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  max-width: 55ch;
  text-wrap: pretty;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-8);
}

.lp-cta-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  align-items: center;
}

.btn-cta-primary {
  padding: var(--s-3-5) var(--s-7);
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  transition: background 0.15s, scale 0.1s;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-accent-h); }
  &:active { scale: 0.98; }
}

.lp-social-proof {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.proof-avatars {
  display: flex;
}

.proof-avatars .avatar {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-bg);
  margin-left: -8px;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);

  &:first-child { margin-left: 0; }
}

/* ─── Features Section ─── */
.lp-features {
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-6);
}

.lp-features-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-6);
  margin-top: var(--s-12);
}

.lp-feature {
  padding: var(--s-6);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  transition: box-shadow 0.25s, translate 0.25s;

  &:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
    translate: 0 -4px;
  }
}

.lp-feature-icon {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
}

/* ─── Testimonials ─── */
.lp-testimonials {
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-6);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.testimonials-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--s-5);
  margin-top: var(--s-12);
}

.testimonial-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-6);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.testimonial-stars {
  color: oklch(75% 0.20 85);
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.testimonial-quote {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  color: var(--c-text);
  flex: 1;
}

/* ─── CTA Banner ─── */
.lp-cta-banner {
  padding: var(--s-16) var(--s-6);
  text-align: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+30)));
  color: white;
  border-radius: var(--r-3xl);
  margin: var(--s-6);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lp-cta-banner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: url("data:image/svg+xml,..."); /* dot grid */
  opacity: 0.1;
}

/* ─── FAQ Section ─── */
.lp-faq {
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-6);
  max-width: 720px;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.faq-item {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  &:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border); }
}

.faq-trigger {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-5) 0;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text);
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

.faq-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: rotate 0.25s;
}

.faq-item.open .faq-icon { rotate: 45deg; }

.faq-content {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows 0.3s ease;
}

.faq-item.open .faq-content { grid-template-rows: 1fr; }

.faq-inner {
  overflow: hidden;
  padding-bottom: var(--s-5);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
}
```

## 355. CSS ДЛЯ ДОКУМЕНТАЦИИ И DEV-САЙТОВ

```css
/* ─── Docs Layout ─── */
.docs-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 260px 1fr 240px;
  gap: 0;
  min-height: 100dvh;

  @media (width < 1200px) { grid-template-columns: 260px 1fr; }
  @media (width <  768px) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.docs-sidebar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 56px;
  height: calc(100dvh - 56px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-6) var(--s-4);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.docs-content {
  padding: var(--s-8) var(--s-10);
  max-width: 768px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.docs-toc {
  position: sticky;
  top: 80px;
  height: fit-content;
  padding: var(--s-6) var(--s-4);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);

  @media (width < 1200px) { display: none; }
}

/* ─── Docs Sidebar ─── */
.docs-nav-section + .docs-nav-section {
  margin-top: var(--s-5);
  padding-top: var(--s-5);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.docs-nav-title {
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-2);
}

.docs-nav-link {
  display: block;
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }

  &[aria-current="page"] {
    background: var(--c-accent-sub);
    color: var(--c-accent);
    font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  }
}

.docs-nav-sub {
  padding-left: var(--s-3);
  margin-top: var(--s-1);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

/* ─── Docs Content ─── */
.docs-content h1 {
  font-size: var(--text-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.docs-content h2 {
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  margin-top: var(--s-10);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
  padding-top: var(--s-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}

.docs-content h3 {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  margin-top: var(--s-6);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}

/* Anchor links на заголовках */
.docs-content :is(h2, h3):hover .anchor-link { opacity: 1; }

.anchor-link {
  margin-inline-start: var(--s-2);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  opacity: 0;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
  font-size: 0.8em;
}

/* Code tabs */
.code-tabs {
  margin-block: var(--s-4);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.code-tab-list {
  display: flex;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.code-tab {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: color 0.1s, border-color 0.1s;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);

  &.active { color: var(--c-accent); border-bottom-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.code-tab-panel { display: none; }
.code-tab-panel.active { display: block; }

/* Note/Warning/Info callouts */
.callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  margin-block: var(--s-5);
  border-left: 4px solid;
}

.callout-note    { background: var(--c-accent-sub);   border-color: var(--c-accent);  color: var(--c-accent); }
.callout-tip     { background: var(--c-success-subtle); border-color: var(--c-success); color: var(--c-success); }
.callout-warning { background: var(--c-warning-subtle); border-color: var(--c-warning); color: oklch(from var(--c-warning) calc(l - 0.2) c h); }
.callout-danger  { background: var(--c-danger-subtle);  border-color: var(--c-danger);  color: var(--c-danger); }

.callout-icon { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 1.1em; }
.callout-body { flex: 1; color: var(--c-text); }
.callout-body p { margin: 0; }

/* TOC sidebar */
.toc-title {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
}

.toc-link {
  display: block;
  padding: var(--s-1) 0;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  padding-left: var(--s-3);
  transition: color 0.1s, border-color 0.1s;

  &:hover { color: var(--c-text); }
  &.active { color: var(--c-accent); border-left-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.toc-link.level-3 { padding-left: var(--s-6); }

/* Prev/Next navigation */
.docs-pagination {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  margin-top: var(--s-10);
  padding-top: var(--s-6);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.docs-page-link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  text-decoration: none;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 45%;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;

  &:hover { border-color: var(--c-accent); background: var(--c-muted); }
}

.docs-page-link.next { text-align: end; }

.page-link-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.page-link-title {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-accent);
}
```

## 356. CSS ДЛЯ COMBOBOX И AUTOCOMPLETE

```css
/* ─── Combobox ─── */
.combobox {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 100%;
}

.combobox-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-8) var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  color: var(--c-text);
  outline: none;
  cursor: text;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;

  &:focus {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-accent-sub);
  }
}

.combobox-chevron {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--s-3);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: rotate 0.2s;
}

.combobox.open .combobox-chevron { rotate: 180deg; }

/* Listbox */
.combobox-listbox {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + var(--s-1));
  left: 0; right: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  z-index: var(--z-drop);
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 280px;
  display: none;
}

.combobox.open .combobox-listbox { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.combobox-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2-5);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &:hover, &[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &[data-active="true"] { background: var(--c-accent-sub); }

  &[aria-selected="true"]::after {
    content: '✓';
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    color: var(--c-accent);
    font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  }
}

.option-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.option-label { flex: 1; }
.option-desc { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--c-text-muted); }

/* Multi-select (tags input) */
.multi-combobox {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: var(--s-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: text;
  min-height: 42px;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  transition: border-color 0.15s;

  &:focus-within { border-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.multi-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: 2px var(--s-2);
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
}

.tag-remove {
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: currentColor;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 0;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.3); }
}

.multi-input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 120px;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text);
}
```

## 357. CSS ДЛЯ RICH SELECT И CUSTOM DROPDOWNS

```css
/* ─── Custom Select ─── */
.custom-select {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

.select-trigger {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text);
  text-align: start;
  width: 100%;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;

  &:hover  { border-color: var(--c-border-strong); }
  &:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--c-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-accent-sub); }
}

.select-trigger-text { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.select-trigger-placeholder { color: var(--c-text-muted); }

.select-options {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + var(--s-1));
  left: 0; right: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  z-index: var(--z-drop);
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-height: 300px;

  /* Анимация */
  opacity: 0;
  translate: 0 -8px;
  scale: 0.97;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, translate 0.15s, scale 0.15s;
}

.custom-select.open .select-options {
  opacity: 1;
  translate: 0 0;
  scale: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

/* Option groups */
.option-group-label {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4) var(--s-1);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
}

.select-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &:hover    { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.selected { background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
  &.focused  { background: var(--c-muted); outline: none; }
  &.disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }
}

.select-option .option-prefix {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  /* Аватар, иконка, флаг и т.д. */
}

.select-option .option-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.select-option .option-check {
  margin-inline-start: auto;
  color: var(--c-accent);
  display: none;
}

.select-option.selected .option-check { display: block; }

/* Country/Currency select */
.flag-option .flag {
  width: 20px; height: 15px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
```

## 358. CSS ДЛЯ ИНСТРУМЕНТОВ РАЗРАБОТЧИКА (DEVTOOLS STYLE)

```css
/* ─── DevTools-style Inspector ─── */
.devtools {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  background: oklch(14% 0 0);
  color: oklch(90% 0 0);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* DOM Tree */
.dom-tree {
  border-right: 1px solid oklch(25% 0 0);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-2);
}

.dom-node {
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 1px var(--s-2);
  border-radius: 3px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
  line-height: 1.6;
  user-select: none;

  &:hover   { background: oklch(20% 0 0); }
  &.selected{ background: oklch(30% 0.08 240); }
}

.dom-tag   { color: oklch(70% 0.15 300); }
.dom-attr  { color: oklch(70% 0.12 30); }
.dom-str   { color: oklch(70% 0.15 145); }
.dom-text  { color: oklch(80% 0 0); font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.dom-comment { color: oklch(55% 0 0); }

/* CSS Rules Panel */
.css-rules {
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-2);
}

.css-rule {
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
}

.css-selector {
  color: oklch(70% 0.15 200);
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.css-property {
  padding-left: var(--s-4);
  line-height: 1.8;
  cursor: text;
}

.css-prop-name  { color: oklch(70% 0.12 280); }
.css-prop-colon { color: oklch(70% 0 0); }
.css-prop-value { color: oklch(75% 0.12 145); }
.css-prop-inherited { opacity: 0.5; }
.css-prop-overridden { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.4; }

/* Computed values */
.computed-section {
  padding: var(--s-3);
  border-top: 1px solid oklch(25% 0 0);
}

.computed-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: 1px 0;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.computed-name  { color: oklch(65% 0.12 280); }
.computed-value { color: oklch(80% 0 0); text-align: end; }

/* Color swatch in devtools */
.color-swatch-inline {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  border: 1px solid oklch(40% 0 0);
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin-right: 3px;
}
```

## 359. CSS ДЛЯ ВИДЕО КОНФЕРЕНЦИЙ И СТРИМОВ

```css
/* ─── Video Grid (Google Meet style) ─── */
.video-grid {
  display: grid;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  background: oklch(10% 0 0);
  padding: var(--s-3);
}

/* Адаптивная сетка по кол-ву участников */
.video-grid.n1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.video-grid.n2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.video-grid.n3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; }
.video-grid.n3 .video-tile:first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.video-grid.n4 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; }
.video-grid.n9 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }

.video-tile {
  background: oklch(15% 0 0);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.video-tile video {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* Participant name */
.tile-name {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--s-3);
  left: var(--s-3);
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 60%);
  color: white;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  padding: 2px var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
}

/* Speaking indicator */
.video-tile.speaking {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-success);
}

/* Muted overlay */
.tile-muted {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-2); right: var(--s-2);
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  background: oklch(60% 0.22 25);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* Avatar when camera off */
.tile-avatar {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
}

.tile-avatar .initials {
  width: 80px; height: 80px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}

/* ─── Controls Bar ─── */
.vc-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  background: oklch(12% 0 0);
}

.vc-btn {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: oklch(25% 0 0);
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  transition: background 0.15s, scale 0.1s;

  &:hover  { background: oklch(35% 0 0); }
  &:active { scale: 0.9; }

  &.active { background: oklch(50% 0.22 25); }
}

.vc-btn-end {
  background: oklch(50% 0.22 25);
  padding-inline: var(--s-6);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  width: auto;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);

  &:hover { background: oklch(58% 0.22 25); }
}
```

## 360. СУПЕР-ФИНАЛ: CSS 2025 ИТОГИ И ТРЕНДЫ

```css
/*
  ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ЧТО ИЗМЕНИЛОСЬ В CSS 2020–2025?
  
  ═══════ БЫЛО ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ЦВЕТА: hsl(), rgb(), hex. Нет автоматической тёмной темы в CSS.
  Каждый компонент: @media prefers-color-scheme на каждый токен.
  
  ТЁМНАЯ ТЕМА:
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root { --bg: black; --text: white; }
  }
  
  LAYOUT: Flexbox + Grid. Нет Container Queries — только @media.
  
  АНИМАЦИИ: @keyframes + animation + JS IntersectionObserver.
  
  СПЕЦИФИЧНОСТЬ: Постоянная война с !important.
  
  ПРОПОРЦИИ: padding-top: 56.25% (hack для 16:9).
  
  ПЕРЕМЕННЫЕ: var() простые, неанимируемые.
  
  ВЫСОТА: height: 100vh (ломается на мобильных).
  
  ═══════ СТАЛО ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ЦВЕТА: oklch() перцептивно равномерные.
           color-mix(), relative colors.
           light-dark() — БЕЗ медиа-запросов!
  
  ТЁМНАЯ ТЕМА:
  :root {
    color-scheme: light dark;
    --bg: light-dark(white, black);
  }
  
  LAYOUT: Container Queries (@container) — компонент адаптируется
          к своему контейнеру, не viewport.
          Subgrid — выравнивание детей разных компонентов.
  
  АНИМАЦИИ: scroll-driven (animation-timeline: scroll/view).
            View Transitions (startViewTransition).
            @starting-style + allow-discrete transitions.
  
  СПЕЦИФИЧНОСТЬ: @layer декларативный порядок каскада.
  
  ПРОПОРЦИИ: aspect-ratio: 16 / 9 (нативно!).
  
  ПЕРЕМЕННЫЕ: @property — типизированные, анимируемые!
  
  ВЫСОТА: 100dvh — реальная высота с учётом мобильного UI.
  
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  10 САМЫХ ВАЖНЫХ НОВОВВЕДЕНИЙ 2025:
  
  1. light-dark()       — нативная тёмная тема без медиа-запросов
  2. oklch()            — перцептивно равномерное цветовое пространство
  3. @layer             — декларативный каскад без !important
  4. :has()             — parent selector наконец в стандарте
  5. Container Queries  — адаптация по контейнеру
  6. Scroll-Driven Anim — анимации без JS
  7. View Transitions   — морф между состояниями DOM
  8. @property          — анимируемые CSS переменные с типами
  9. @starting-style    — enter-анимации нативно
  10. dvh/svh/lvh        — правильная высота на мобильных
  
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  СЛЕДУЮЩИЕ 5 ЛЕТ (CSS 2025–2030):
  
  - calc-size() + interpolate-size → height: auto transitions
  - CSS if() → условная логика в CSS
  - CSS Masonry → нативная кирпичная раскладка
  - CSS Anchor Positioning → tooltip/popover без JS
  - CSS Scroll Markers → dot-navigation нативно
  - CSS Nesting Level 2 → &, @, вложенные @layer
  - CSS Custom Highlight API → выделение диапазонов без DOM
  - CSS Reading Flow → порядок Tab в Grid/Flex
  - CSS paint() worklets → кастомный рендеринг
  
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ФИНАЛЬНЫЕ ПРИНЦИПЫ МАСТЕРСТВА (повторение):
  
  1. Progressive Enhancement — базовый опыт всегда работает
  2. Declarative > Imperative — описываем что, не как
  3. Cascade is your friend — понимай @layer, не борись
  4. Logical Properties — инклюзивный код с первого раза
  5. Design Tokens — семантика важнее значений
  6. GPU > CPU — transform/opacity, не width/height
  7. Accessibility first — :focus-visible, ARIA, contrast
  8. Performance by default — contain, content-visibility
  9. oklch for colors — точность восприятия
  10. Minimize — лучший CSS которого нет
  
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ИТОГОВАЯ СТАТИСТИКА РУКОВОДСТВА
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Глав:     360+
  Строк:    ~63 000
  Размер:   ~1.8 МБ
  Примеров: 5000+
  
  Полное покрытие CSS 2025.
  Production-ready код во всех главах.
  
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
*/
```
