## 361. CSS ДЛЯ AI ИНТЕРФЕЙСОВ — CHAT И СТРИМИНГ

```css
/* ─── AI Chat Interface ─── */
.ai-chat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100dvh;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  background: var(--c-bg);
}

/* Messages scroll area */
.ai-messages {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-6) var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-6);
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* ─── Message bubbles ─── */
.ai-message {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  align-items: flex-start;
  animation: msg-appear 0.3s var(--ease-out) both;
}

@keyframes msg-appear {
  from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 12px; }
}

/* User message */
.ai-message.user {
  flex-direction: row-reverse;
}

.ai-message.user .msg-bubble {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl) var(--r-sm) var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl);
}

/* Assistant message */
.ai-message.assistant .msg-bubble {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm) var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl);
}

.msg-bubble {
  max-width: 85%;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  word-break: break-word;
}

/* AI Avatar */
.ai-avatar {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+40)));
  color: white;
}

/* ─── Streaming text cursor ─── */
.streaming-cursor {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 2px;
  height: 1.1em;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  margin-left: 1px;
  vertical-align: text-bottom;
  border-radius: 1px;
  animation: cursor-blink 0.7s step-end infinite;
}

@keyframes cursor-blink {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50%       { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Typing dots (while AI is thinking) */
.thinking-bubble {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  align-items: center;
}

.think-dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-text-muted);
  animation: think-anim 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.think-dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.think-dot:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.30s; }

@keyframes think-anim {
  0%, 60%, 100% { scale: 1; opacity: 0.5; }
  30%           { scale: 1.3; opacity: 1; }
}

/* ─── Markdown в AI ответах ─── */
.ai-message .msg-bubble h1,
.ai-message .msg-bubble h2,
.ai-message .msg-bubble h3 { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); margin-block: var(--s-3) var(--s-2); }

.ai-message .msg-bubble code {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-muted) l c h / 0.8);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.875em;
}

.ai-message .msg-bubble pre {
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-block: var(--s-3);
}

.ai-message .msg-bubble pre code { background: none; padding: 0; }

.ai-message .msg-bubble ul,
.ai-message .msg-bubble ol { padding-inline-start: 1.5em; margin-block: var(--s-2); }
.ai-message .msg-bubble li { margin-block: var(--s-1); }
.ai-message .msg-bubble p  { margin-block-end: var(--s-2); }
.ai-message .msg-bubble p:last-child { margin-block-end: 0; }

/* ─── Action buttons on message ─── */
.msg-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  opacity: 0;
  margin-top: var(--s-2);
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.ai-message:hover .msg-actions { opacity: 1; }

.msg-action-btn {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: none;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-border); color: var(--c-text); }
}

/* ─── AI Input area ─── */
.ai-input-area {
  padding: var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.ai-input-wrap {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;

  &:focus-within {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-accent-sub);
  }
}

.ai-textarea {
  flex: 1;
  resize: none;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
  min-height: 24px;
  max-height: 200px;
  field-sizing: content;

  &::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}

.ai-send {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.15s, scale 0.1s;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-accent-h); }
  &:active { scale: 0.9; }
  &:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
}

/* Stop generation button */
.ai-stop {
  background: var(--c-muted);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-border); }
}

/* Suggestions chips */
.ai-suggestions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
}

.suggestion-chip {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s, border-color 0.1s;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); border-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

/* ─── Token counter ─── */
.token-counter {
  text-align: end;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-1-5);
}

.token-counter.near-limit { color: var(--c-warning); }
.token-counter.at-limit   { color: var(--c-danger); }
```

## 362. CSS ДЛЯ FOLDABLE / DUAL SCREEN УСТРОЙСТВ

```css
/*
  CSS для складных телефонов (Samsung Fold, Surface Duo).
  viewport-segments — новое CSS API.
  
  Поддержка: Chrome 93+ (за флагом), Edge 93+
*/

/* ─── Определить dual-screen ─── */
@media (spanning: single-fold-vertical) {
  /* Вертикальный сгиб — экраны слева/справа */
  .app {
    display: flex;
    gap: env(fold-width, 0px);
    /* fold-width — ширина сгиба (физический шов) */
  }

  .sidebar  { width: env(fold-left, 50%); }
  .main     { width: env(fold-right, 50%); }
}

@media (spanning: single-fold-horizontal) {
  /* Горизонтальный сгиб — экраны сверху/снизу */
  .app {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: env(fold-height, 0px);
  }

  .top-panel    { height: env(fold-top, 50%); }
  .bottom-panel { height: env(fold-bottom, 50%); }
}

/* ─── CSS Grid Spanning API (новее) ─── */
/*
  viewport-segments — массив прямоугольников каждого сегмента
  
  @media (horizontal-viewport-segments: 2) {
    // Два горизонтальных сегмента (side by side)
    .dual-pane {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        env(viewport-segment-width 0 0)
        env(viewport-segment-width 1 0);
      gap: calc(env(viewport-segment-left 1 0) - env(viewport-segment-right 0 0));
    }
  }
*/

/* ─── Fallback — обычный responsive ─── */
@supports not (spanning: single-fold-vertical) {
  .app {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  @media (width >= 768px) {
    .app { flex-direction: row; }
    .sidebar { width: 260px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .main    { flex: 1; }
  }
}

/* ─── Tent mode (горизонтально открытый) ─── */
@media (spanning: single-fold-horizontal) {
  /* Верхний экран — медиа/контент */
  .tent-top {
    height: env(fold-top, 50vh);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Нижний экран — управление */
  .tent-bottom {
    height: env(fold-bottom, 50vh);
    background: var(--c-surface);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    padding: var(--s-4);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

/* ─── Book mode (вертикально открытый) ─── */
@media (spanning: single-fold-vertical) {
  .book-left  { overflow-y: auto; }
  .book-right { overflow-y: auto; }

  /* Скрыть навигацию на левом экране */
  .book-left .mobile-nav { display: none; }
}
```

## 363. CSS ДЛЯ БОЛЬШИХ ЭКРАНОВ (TV, 4K, УЛЬТРАШИРОКИЕ)

```css
/*
  CSS для TV (10-foot UI), 4K мониторов, ultrawide дисплеев.
*/

/* ─── 10-foot UI (TV) ─── */
@media (min-width: 1920px) and (pointer: coarse) {
  /* TV — смотрят с 3 метров */
  html { font-size: 24px; }

  .btn {
    min-width: 120px;
    min-height: 60px;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }

  /* Фокус — очень заметный */
  :focus-visible {
    outline: 4px solid white;
    outline-offset: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.5);
  }
}

/* ─── Ultrawide (21:9 и шире) ─── */
@media (min-aspect-ratio: 21/9) {
  .app-shell {
    /* Не растягивать сайдбар */
    grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(0, 900px) 1fr;
  }

  /* Контент всегда по центру */
  .page { max-width: 1000px; }

  /* Боковые поля — не пустые */
  .main-layout::before,
  .main-layout::after {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    flex: 1;
    background: var(--c-muted);
  }
}

/* ─── 4K / Retina ─── */
@media (min-resolution: 2dppx) {
  /* Острые иконки */
  .icon { image-rendering: crisp-edges; }

  /* Утончённые бордеры */
  .card { border-width: 0.5px; }
}

/* ─── Fluid max-width по экрану ─── */
:root {
  /* Никогда не читать текст шире 1200px */
  --max-content: min(100%, 1280px);
  --max-text:    min(100%, 65ch);
  --max-form:    min(100%, 480px);
}

.container {
  max-width: var(--max-content);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: clamp(var(--s-4), 5vw, var(--s-12));
}

/* ─── CSS для проекторов/презентаций ─── */
@media projection {
  body { font-size: 18pt; }
  * { color: black !important; background: white !important; }
  .slide { min-height: 100vh; page-break-after: always; }
}

/* ─── Env переменные для будущих устройств ─── */
.future-ready {
  /* Всегда использовать safe area */
  padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0)
           env(safe-area-inset-right, 0)
           env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0)
           env(safe-area-inset-left, 0);
}
```

## 364. CSS ДЛЯ REAL-TIME ДАННЫХ (LIVE ТИКЕРЫ)

```css
/* ─── Live indicator ─── */
.live-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: 3px var(--s-2-5);
  background: var(--c-danger);
  color: white;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.live-dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: white;
  animation: live-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes live-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; scale: 1; }
  50%       { opacity: 0.5; scale: 0.7; }
}

/* ─── Stock Ticker ─── */
.ticker {
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  padding: var(--s-2) 0;
  border-block: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ticker-track {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: var(--s-8);
  animation: ticker-scroll 30s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes ticker-scroll {
  from { translate: 0 0; }
  to   { translate: -50% 0; }
}

.ticker:hover .ticker-track { animation-play-state: paused; }

.ticker-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.ticker-symbol { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); }
.ticker-price  { }

.ticker-change {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  padding: 1px var(--s-1-5);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
}

.ticker-change.up   { background: oklch(from var(--c-success) l c h / 0.15); color: var(--c-success); }
.ticker-change.down { background: oklch(from var(--c-danger)  l c h / 0.15); color: var(--c-danger);  }

/* ─── Realtime score board ─── */
.scoreboard {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.score-header {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-5);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
}

.score-match {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  padding: var(--s-5);
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.team-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-3); }
.team-info.away { flex-direction: row-reverse; text-align: end; }

.team-score {
  font-size: var(--text-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  justify-content: center;
}

.score-sep { font-size: var(--text-2xl); color: var(--c-text-muted); }

/* Score change animation */
@keyframes score-bump {
  0% { scale: 1; }
  30% { scale: 1.4; color: var(--c-success); }
  100% { scale: 1; }
}

.score-changed { animation: score-bump 0.6s var(--ease-spring); }

/* ─── Real-time chart (sparkline live) ─── */
.live-chart {
  position: relative;
  height: 60px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.live-line {
  stroke: var(--c-accent);
  stroke-width: 2;
  fill: none;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.live-area {
  fill: url(#live-gradient);
  opacity: 0.3;
}

/* New data point slide in */
@keyframes chart-slide {
  from { translate: 20px 0; }
  to   { translate: 0 0; }
}

.live-chart svg { animation: chart-slide 0.3s ease; }

/* ─── Countdown Timer ─── */
.countdown {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.countdown-unit {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.countdown-value {
  font-size: var(--text-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 2ch;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Flip animation */
@keyframes flip-in {
  from { translate: 0 -100%; }
}

.countdown-value.changed { animation: flip-in 0.3s ease; }

.countdown-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
}

.countdown-sep {
  font-size: var(--text-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  align-self: flex-start;
  line-height: 1;
}
```

## 365. CSS ДЛЯ KANBAN И TASK MANAGEMENT

```css
/* ─── Kanban Layout ─── */
.kanban-board {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: var(--s-4);
  align-items: flex-start;
  min-height: calc(100dvh - 100px);
  overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

/* ─── Kanban Column ─── */
.kanban-col {
  flex: 0 0 280px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 140px);
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

.kanban-col.drag-over {
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  outline: 2px dashed var(--c-accent);
}

.kanban-col-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.col-dot {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.col-title {
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  flex: 1;
}

.col-count {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  background: var(--c-border);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  padding: 2px var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  min-width: 20px;
  text-align: center;
}

.kanban-cards {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-3);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  min-height: 80px;
}

/* Add card button */
.kanban-add {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 100%;
  transition: color 0.1s;
  font: inherit;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl);

  &:hover { color: var(--c-text); background: var(--c-border); }
}

/* ─── Kanban Card ─── */
.kanban-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  cursor: grab;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s, translate 0.15s;
  position: relative;

  &:hover { box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }
  &:active { cursor: grabbing; }
}

.kanban-card.dragging {
  rotate: 2deg;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  opacity: 0.9;
  z-index: var(--z-modal);
}

.card-title {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
}

.card-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  line-height: var(--lh-normal);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Card labels */
.card-labels {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

.card-label {
  height: 6px;
  min-width: 32px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Card footer */
.card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  margin-top: var(--s-1);
}

.card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.card-due-date { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-1); }
.card-due-date.overdue { color: var(--c-danger); }

.card-assignees {
  display: flex;
}

.assignee-avatar {
  width: 24px; height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-surface);
  margin-left: -8px;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  &:first-child { margin-left: 0; }
}

/* ─── Column WIP limit ─── */
.col-wip-bar {
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: var(--s-1) var(--s-3);
}

.col-wip-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-success);
  width: calc(var(--current) / var(--max) * 100%);
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: width 0.3s;
}

.kanban-col.at-limit .col-wip-fill { background: var(--c-danger); }

/* ─── Swimlanes ─── */
.swimlane {
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
}

.swimlane-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-3);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.swimlane-toggle { transition: rotate 0.2s; }
.swimlane.collapsed .swimlane-toggle { rotate: -90deg; }
.swimlane.collapsed .kanban-cards { display: none; }
```

## 366. CSS ДЛЯ GANTT ДИАГРАММ И TIMELINE

```css
/* ─── Gantt Chart ─── */
.gantt {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background: var(--c-surface);
}

/* Task list (left) */
.gantt-tasks {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.gantt-task-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: 0 var(--s-3);
  height: 40px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

.task-indent { flex-shrink: 0; }
.task-name {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}

/* Timeline (right) */
.gantt-timeline {
  overflow: auto;
}

.gantt-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  display: flex;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  z-index: 1;
}

.gantt-col-header {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--s-2);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  min-width: var(--col-width, 32px);
}

.gantt-col-header.today {
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  color: var(--c-accent);
}

/* Grid rows */
.gantt-row {
  display: flex;
  height: 40px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  position: relative;
  align-items: center;
}

.gantt-cell {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: var(--col-width, 32px);
  height: 100%;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
}

.gantt-cell.today { background: var(--c-accent-sub); opacity: 0.3; }
.gantt-cell.weekend { background: var(--c-muted); }

/* Task bar */
.gantt-bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--c-accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding-inline: var(--s-2);
  cursor: grab;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: white;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: filter 0.15s;
  left: calc(var(--start) * var(--col-width, 32px));
  width: calc(var(--duration) * var(--col-width, 32px) - 2px);

  &:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }
  &:active { cursor: grabbing; }
}

.gantt-bar.critical { background: var(--c-danger); }
.gantt-bar.milestone {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 0;
  rotate: 45deg;
  top: 10px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: visible;
}

/* Progress inside bar */
.gantt-bar-progress {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: oklch(from currentColor l c h / 0.4);
  width: var(--progress, 0%);
  border-radius: inherit;
}

/* Dependency arrows — SVG overlay */
.gantt-deps {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dep-line {
  stroke: var(--c-text-muted);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  fill: none;
  stroke-dasharray: 4 2;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* Today line */
.today-line {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--c-danger);
  left: calc(var(--today-offset) * var(--col-width, 32px));
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.today-line::before {
  content: 'Сегодня';
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  left: 4px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--c-danger);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
}
```

## 367. CSS ДЛЯ SPREADSHEET-ПОДОБНЫХ ТАБЛИЦ

```css
/* ─── Spreadsheet Container ─── */
.spreadsheet {
  overflow: auto;
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  max-height: 600px;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

/* ─── Grid ─── */
.ss-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
}

/* Row header (numbers) */
.ss-row-header {
  position: sticky;
  left: 0;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  z-index: 2;
  min-width: 48px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  user-select: none;
}

/* Column header (A, B, C...) */
.ss-col-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  z-index: 2;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-border); }
}

/* Corner cell */
.ss-corner {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--c-border);
}

/* Data cells */
.ss-cell {
  min-width: 100px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 var(--s-2);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  cursor: cell;
  outline: none;
  vertical-align: middle;
  transition: background 0.05s;
}

.ss-cell.selected {
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent);
  outline-offset: -2px;
  z-index: 1;
  position: relative;
}

.ss-cell.editing {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent);
  outline-offset: -2px;
  overflow: visible;
  z-index: 5;
}

/* Selection range */
.ss-cell.in-range { background: var(--c-accent-sub); opacity: 0.6; }

/* Row/column highlighted when selected */
.ss-row.selected .ss-row-header,
.ss-col-header.selected { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; }

/* Cell types */
.ss-cell.type-number   { text-align: end; color: oklch(45% 0.18 250); }
.ss-cell.type-formula  { color: oklch(45% 0.18 145); }
.ss-cell.type-date     { color: oklch(45% 0.18 300); }
.ss-cell.type-error    { color: var(--c-danger); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); }

/* Frozen rows/columns */
.ss-frozen-row {
  position: sticky;
  top: 28px; /* below column headers */
  z-index: 1;
  background: oklch(from var(--c-muted) l c h / 0.95);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--c-border);
}

.ss-frozen-col {
  position: sticky;
  left: 48px; /* after row header */
  z-index: 1;
  background: oklch(from var(--c-surface) l c h / 0.97);
  border-right: 2px solid var(--c-border);
}

/* ─── Formula bar ─── */
.formula-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.cell-reference {
  min-width: 60px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  padding-right: var(--s-3);
}

.formula-input {
  flex: 1;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font: inherit;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text);
}
```

## 368. CSS ДЛЯ AUDIO ПЛЕЕРА

```css
/* ─── Audio Player ─── */
.audio-player {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
}

/* Track info */
.track-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

.track-art {
  width: 56px; height: 56px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  object-fit: cover;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Rotating disc when playing */
.audio-player.playing .track-art::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  animation: disc-spin 4s linear infinite;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50%, transparent 30%, oklch(0% 0 0 / 20%) 100%);
}

@keyframes disc-spin { to { rotate: 360deg; } }

.track-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.track-title {
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.track-artist {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.track-action {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: color 0.1s, background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
  &.liked { color: oklch(60% 0.22 15); }
}

/* Progress bar */
.audio-progress {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.progress-bar {
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: height 0.15s;

  &:hover { height: 6px; }
}

.progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: width 0.1s linear;
  width: var(--progress, 0%);
}

/* Controls */
.audio-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

.control-btn {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  transition: color 0.1s, background 0.1s, scale 0.1s;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
  &:active { scale: 0.9; }
  &.active { color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.play-btn {
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  font-size: 1.4rem;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-accent-h); scale: 1.05; }
  &:active { scale: 0.95; }
}

/* Volume */
.audio-volume {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.volume-slider {
  width: 80px;
  height: 3px;
  accent-color: var(--c-accent);
}

/* Visualizer bars */
.audio-viz {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 24px;
}

.viz-bar {
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
  height: 4px;
  transition: height 0.1s;
}

.audio-player.playing .viz-bar {
  animation: viz-dance 0.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 50ms);
}

@keyframes viz-dance {
  from { height: 4px; }
  to   { height: calc(4px + var(--h, 12) * 1px); }
}

/* Equalizer mode */
.equalizer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: var(--s-3);
  align-items: end;
  padding: var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
}

.eq-band { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); }
.eq-slider { height: 80px; writing-mode: vertical-lr; appearance: slider-vertical; }
.eq-label { font-size: 10px; color: var(--c-text-muted); }

/* Playlist */
.playlist {
  max-height: 200px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.playlist-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);

  &:hover   { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.current { background: var(--c-accent-sub); color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.playlist-num {
  width: 20px;
  text-align: end;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.playlist-item.current .playlist-num {
  /* Animated playing indicator */
}
```

## 369. CSS ДЛЯ РАСШИРЕННОЙ ТИПОГРАФИКИ

```css
/* ─── Advanced Typography Effects ─── */

/* Strikethrough with custom style */
.strikethrough {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

.strikethrough::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--c-danger);
  border-radius: 1px;
}

/* Wavy underline */
.wavy-underline {
  text-decoration: underline wavy var(--c-accent);
  text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}

/* Highlight marker */
.marker {
  background: linear-gradient(
    transparent 40%,
    oklch(90% 0.20 85 / 70%) 40%,
    oklch(90% 0.20 85 / 70%) 90%,
    transparent 90%
  );
  padding: 0 2px;
}

/* Colored marker variants */
.marker-blue {
  background: linear-gradient(
    transparent 40%,
    oklch(85% 0.15 260 / 60%) 40%,
    oklch(85% 0.15 260 / 60%) 90%,
    transparent 90%
  );
}

.marker-green {
  background: linear-gradient(
    transparent 40%,
    oklch(85% 0.15 145 / 60%) 40%,
    oklch(85% 0.15 145 / 60%) 90%,
    transparent 90%
  );
}

/* Animated underline draw */
@keyframes underline-draw {
  from { background-size: 0 2px; }
  to   { background-size: 100% 2px; }
}

.draw-underline {
  background-image: linear-gradient(var(--c-accent), var(--c-accent));
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: 0 100%;
  background-size: 0 2px;
  transition: background-size 0.4s ease;
}

.draw-underline:hover { background-size: 100% 2px; }

/* Outlined/hollow text */
.text-outlined {
  -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--c-text);
  color: transparent;
}

/* Mixed fill+outline */
.text-mixed {
  -webkit-text-stroke: 1px var(--c-accent);
  color: var(--c-text);
}

/* Text clipping (image inside letters) */
.text-image-clip {
  background: url('/images/texture.jpg') center / cover;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

/* Kinetic text (per-character animation) */
.kinetic-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.kinetic-text .char {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: char-wave 1s ease-in-out infinite;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 0.05s);
}

@keyframes char-wave {
  0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; }
  50%       { translate: 0 -8px; }
}

/* Typewriter effect */
@keyframes typewriter {
  from { width: 0; }
}

@keyframes blink-caret {
  50% { border-color: transparent; }
}

.typewriter {
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border-right: 2px solid var(--c-accent);
  width: fit-content;
  animation:
    typewriter 2s steps(var(--chars, 30)) forwards,
    blink-caret 0.5s step-end infinite;
}

/* Blurred text (spoiler) */
.spoiler {
  filter: blur(4px);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: filter 0.3s;
  user-select: none;

  &:hover, &.revealed { filter: none; user-select: auto; }
}

/* Letter spacing animation */
@keyframes letter-expand {
  from { letter-spacing: -0.1em; opacity: 0; }
  to   { letter-spacing: 0.1em; opacity: 1; }
}

.letter-expand { animation: letter-expand 0.8s ease both; }

/* Gradient animated text */
@property --text-gradient-pos {
  syntax: '<percentage>';
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0%;
}

.shimmer-text {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--c-text) 0%,
    var(--c-accent) var(--text-gradient-pos),
    var(--c-text) 100%
  );
  background-size: 200%;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  animation: shimmer-text-anim 2s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer-text-anim {
  from { --text-gradient-pos: -50%; background-position: 200% center; }
  to   { --text-gradient-pos: 150%; background-position: -200% center; }
}

/* Rotated label */
.rotated-label {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  rotate: 180deg;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* Tabular figures (важно для таблиц) */
.mono-numbers {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-feature-settings: 'tnum';
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

/* Small caps */
.small-caps-text {
  font-variant-caps: small-caps;
  font-feature-settings: 'smcp';
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
```

## 370. CSS ПРОИЗВОДИТЕЛЬНОСТЬ — ПРОФИЛИРОВАНИЕ В ДЕТАЛЯХ

```css
/*
  Детальный гайд по профилированию CSS производительности.
  Метрики, инструменты, паттерны.
*/

/* ─── Layout Thrashing Prevention ─── */
/*
  Layout Thrashing = цикл чтение→запись→чтение→запись в JS.
  Каждое чтение после записи вызывает forced reflow.
  
  BAD:
  elements.forEach(el => {
    const h = el.offsetHeight; // читаем — reflow
    el.style.height = h + 'px'; // пишем
    // следующая итерация = reflow снова!
  });
  
  GOOD (batch read + write):
  const heights = elements.map(el => el.offsetHeight); // все reads
  elements.forEach((el, i) => el.style.height = heights[i] + 'px'); // все writes
*/

/* CSS решение: использовать transform вместо top/left */
.optimized-move {
  translate: var(--x, 0) var(--y, 0); /* GPU, не reflow */
}

/* ─── Selector Performance ─── */
/*
  Браузер читает CSS СПРАВА НАЛЕВО.
  Правый ключевой элемент — самый частый элемент поиска.
  
  Медленно: .sidebar .nav .item a.active (много <a> на странице)
  Быстро:   .nav-link--active (один конкретный класс)
  
  Правило: ключевой (правый) элемент должен быть РЕДКИМ и КОНКРЕТНЫМ.
*/

/* ─── contain: strict для изоляции ─── */
.widget-isolated {
  contain: strict;
  width: 300px;  /* обязательно с contain: strict */
  height: 200px;
  /* Любые изменения внутри widget не вызывают reflow снаружи */
}

/* ─── content-visibility стратегия ─── */

/* Секции ниже fold — lazy render */
.section-below-fold {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 400px; /* примерная высота */
  /* Экономим 80% времени рендеринга для off-screen секций */
}

/* ─── Paint Worklet альтернатива ─── */
/*
  Вместо gradient на многих элементах — один background-image через paint():
  .multiple-elements { background: paint(shared-gradient); }
  
  Браузер вызывает paint worklet один раз, кэширует.
*/

/* ─── CSS Animation Performance Checklist ─── */
/*
  ✅ translate, scale, rotate, opacity → GPU composite (60fps)
  ✅ will-change: transform → заранее создать compositing layer
  ✅ backface-visibility: hidden → подсказка для GPU
  
  ❌ width, height, padding, margin в animation → reflow каждый кадр
  ❌ top, left, right, bottom (position: absolute) → reflow
  ❌ font-size, line-height → reflow
  ❌ background-color в keyframes (не transition) → repaint (OK для transition)
  
  Исключения (modern browsers optimise):
  - clip-path анимация → иногда GPU
  - filter анимация → GPU в большинстве браузеров
*/

/* ─── Forced Layer для критических анимаций ─── */
.critical-animation {
  will-change: transform; /* создать compositing layer ЗАРАНЕЕ */
}

/* Убрать после анимации (через JS) */
.critical-animation.done {
  will-change: auto; /* освободить GPU memory */
}

/* ─── CSS Grid Subgrid Performance ─── */
/*
  Subgrid НЕ медленнее обычного Grid в современных браузерах.
  Он избегает нескольких layout passes.
  Рекомендуется для card grids с выравниванием.
*/

/* ─── Scroll Performance ─── */
.scroll-container {
  overflow-y: auto;
  will-change: scroll-position; /* hint для браузера */
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  /* При этом: scroll compositor thread — 60fps без main thread */
}

/* ─── Image Loading Performance ─── */
img {
  loading: lazy;           /* native lazy loading */
  decoding: async;         /* не блокировать main thread при decode */
  fetchpriority: auto;     /* auto | high | low */
}

img.hero-img {
  loading: eager;          /* выше fold — загрузить сразу */
  fetchpriority: high;     /* приоритетная загрузка */
  decoding: sync;          /* ждать decode (избежать layout shift) */
}

/* ─── CSS Bundle Size Optimization ─── */
/*
  1. PurgeCSS — удалить неиспользуемые классы
  2. cssnano — минификация (shorthand, убрать комментарии)
  3. Brotli compression — лучше gzip на 20-30%
  4. HTTP/2 Push для critical CSS
  5. CSS Modules hash — агрессивное кэширование
  
  Целевые метрики:
  - Critical CSS: < 14KB (TCP slow start limit)
  - Total CSS: < 50KB gzipped
  - Specificity graph: ровный рост, без пиков
  - Selector depth: ≤ 3 уровня
*/
```

## 371. CSS ДЛЯ ЭКРАНОВ С ВЫСОКИМ КОНТРАСТОМ — EXTENDED

```css
/*
  Расширенный гайд по high contrast mode:
  Windows HCM, macOS Increase Contrast, Android High Contrast.
  
  CSS для каждого сценария.
*/

/* ─── Windows High Contrast Mode ─── */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  /* Всё что нарисовано через CSS — теряет цвет.
     Остаётся: border, outline, text-decoration, box-shadow (монохром).
     
     Правило 1: всегда добавлять border к интерактивным элементам.
     Правило 2: не скрывать focus outline.
     Правило 3: не использовать только цвет как индикатор.
  */

  /* Кнопки */
  .btn {
    border: 2px solid ButtonText;
    background: ButtonFace;
    color: ButtonText;
    forced-color-adjust: none; /* наши цвета, не системные */
  }

  .btn:hover {
    background: Highlight;
    color: HighlightText;
    border-color: Highlight;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    background: Highlight;
    color: HighlightText;
    border-color: Highlight;
  }

  /* Карточки */
  .card {
    border: 1px solid ButtonBorder;
    background: Canvas;
    color: CanvasText;
  }

  /* Иконки */
  .icon svg {
    fill: ButtonText;
    forced-color-adjust: none;
  }

  /* Кастомные checkbox / radio */
  .custom-check {
    border: 2px solid ButtonBorder;
    background: Field;
    color: FieldText;
    forced-color-adjust: none;
  }

  .custom-check:checked {
    background: Highlight;
    border-color: Highlight;
    color: HighlightText;
  }

  /* Focus */
  :focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid Highlight;
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  /* Links */
  a { color: LinkText; }
  a:visited { color: VisitedText; }
  a:hover { color: ActiveText; }

  /* Badges / tags */
  .badge {
    border: 1px solid ButtonBorder;
    background: Canvas;
    color: CanvasText;
    forced-color-adjust: none;
  }

  /* Input fields */
  input, textarea, select {
    background: Field;
    color: FieldText;
    border: 1px solid ButtonBorder;
    forced-color-adjust: none;
  }

  input:focus, textarea:focus {
    outline: 3px solid Highlight;
    outline-offset: -1px;
  }

  /* Disabled */
  :disabled {
    color: GrayText;
    border-color: GrayText;
  }

  /* Shadows → remove (invisible in HCM) */
  * {
    box-shadow: none !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
  }

  /* SVG shapes — add stroke */
  .decorative-shape { stroke: CanvasText; stroke-width: 1px; fill: Canvas; }

  /* Images — don't adjust (forced-color-adjust: none) */
  img { forced-color-adjust: none; }

  /* Skeleton loading → border */
  .skeleton {
    border: 1px solid ButtonBorder;
    background: transparent;
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ─── macOS Increase Contrast ─── */
@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
  :root {
    --c-border:      oklch(50% 0 0);
    --c-border-strong: oklch(30% 0 0);
    --c-text-muted:  oklch(35% 0 0);
    --shadow-sm: none;
    --shadow-md: none;
    --shadow-lg: none;
    --shadow-xl: none;
  }

  .card { border-width: 2px; }
  .btn  { border-width: 2px; }

  :focus-visible {
    outline-width: 3px;
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  .text-muted { color: var(--c-text); } /* no muted in high contrast */
}

/* ─── inverted-colors media query ─── */
@media (inverted-colors: inverted) {
  /* ОС инвертировала цвета. Images и video — инвертированы!
     Нужно "de-invert" их обратно. */
  img, video, canvas {
    filter: invert(1);
  }

  /* SVG иконки тоже инвертированы */
  svg { filter: invert(1); }
}
```

## 372. CSS АНИМИРОВАННЫЕ ИЛЛЮСТРАЦИИ

```css
/* ─── CSS Illustration: Robot ─── */
.css-robot {
  width: 120px;
  height: 160px;
  position: relative;
  margin: auto;
}

.robot-head {
  width: 80px; height: 60px;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  animation: robot-bob 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes robot-bob {
  0%, 100% { translate: -50% 0; }
  50%       { translate: -50% -6px; }
}

.robot-eye {
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
}

.robot-eye::after {
  content: '';
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: oklch(10% 0 0);
  border-radius: 50%;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% -50%;
  animation: robot-blink 3s step-end infinite;
}

@keyframes robot-blink {
  0%, 90%, 100% { scale: 1 1; }
  95%           { scale: 1 0.1; }
}

.robot-eye.left  { left: 14px; }
.robot-eye.right { right: 14px; }

.robot-body {
  width: 100%; height: 70px;
  background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) calc(l - 0.1) c h);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 30px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.robot-panel {
  width: 50px; height: 36px;
  background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) calc(l + 0.1) c h);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px;
  align-content: flex-start;
}

.robot-btn {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.robot-btn.red    { background: var(--c-danger);  animation: btn-blink 1.5s ease infinite; }
.robot-btn.green  { background: var(--c-success); animation: btn-blink 2s 0.5s ease infinite; }
.robot-btn.yellow { background: var(--c-warning); animation: btn-blink 2.5s 1s ease infinite; }

@keyframes btn-blink {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50%       { opacity: 0.3; }
}

/* ─── Loading Animation: Coffee ─── */
.coffee-loader {
  position: relative;
  width: 60px; height: 80px;
}

.coffee-cup {
  width: 50px; height: 40px;
  border: 4px solid var(--c-text);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl);
  border-top: none;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 5px;
}

.coffee-cup::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px; right: -14px;
  width: 12px; height: 18px;
  border: 4px solid var(--c-text);
  border-left: none;
  border-radius: 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) 0;
}

.coffee-liquid {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 4px; left: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  height: 20px;
  background: oklch(50% 0.15 35);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl);
  animation: coffee-fill 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes coffee-fill {
  from { height: 10px; }
  to   { height: 22px; }
}

.steam {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 12px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.steam-line {
  width: 4px;
  height: 20px;
  background: var(--c-text-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  animation: steam-rise 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  opacity: 0;
}

.steam-line:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.steam-line:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1s; }

@keyframes steam-rise {
  0%   { translate: 0 0; opacity: 0; }
  30%  { opacity: 0.7; }
  100% { translate: 0 -20px; opacity: 0; }
}

/* ─── Animated Logo / Wordmark ─── */
.animated-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.logo-icon {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  animation: logo-spin 8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes logo-spin {
  to { rotate: 360deg; }
}

.logo-text .char {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: logo-char-in 0.5s var(--ease-out) both;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 0.05s);
}

@keyframes logo-char-in {
  from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 -8px; }
}
```

## 373. CSS ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ ПОЛНЫЙ СПРАВОЧНИК СВОЙСТВ

```css
/*
  Полный алфавитный список CSS свойств с примерами значений.
  Reference для быстрого поиска.
*/

.complete-reference {
  /* ─── A ─── */
  accent-color:           auto | var(--c-accent);
  align-content:          normal | flex-start | flex-end | center | space-between | space-around | space-evenly | stretch | start | end | baseline;
  align-items:            normal | flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline | stretch | start | end | self-start | self-end;
  align-self:             auto | flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline | stretch;
  all:                    initial | inherit | unset | revert | revert-layer;
  animation:              name duration timing-function delay iteration-count direction fill-mode;
  animation-composition:  replace | add | accumulate;
  animation-delay:        0s | 0.3s;
  animation-direction:    normal | reverse | alternate | alternate-reverse;
  animation-duration:     0.3s | 1.5s;
  animation-fill-mode:    none | forwards | backwards | both;
  animation-iteration-count: 1 | infinite | 2.5;
  animation-name:         none | keyframe-name;
  animation-play-state:   running | paused;
  animation-range:        normal | entry 0% | exit 50%;
  animation-timeline:     auto | scroll() | view() | --named;
  animation-timing-function: ease | linear | ease-in | ease-out | ease-in-out | cubic-bezier() | steps() | linear();
  appearance:             none | auto | button | textfield | searchfield;
  aspect-ratio:           auto | 16/9 | 1 | 4/3;

  /* ─── B ─── */
  backdrop-filter:        none | blur(4px) | brightness(1.2) | saturate(2);
  backface-visibility:    visible | hidden;
  background:             shorthand;
  background-attachment:  scroll | fixed | local;
  background-blend-mode:  normal | multiply | screen | overlay | darken | lighten;
  background-clip:        border-box | padding-box | content-box | text;
  background-color:       transparent | oklch(55% 0.22 260);
  background-image:       none | url() | linear-gradient() | radial-gradient();
  background-origin:      padding-box | border-box | content-box;
  background-position:    center | top right | 50% 50% | right 20px bottom 10px;
  background-repeat:      repeat | no-repeat | repeat-x | repeat-y | round | space;
  background-size:        auto | cover | contain | 100px 50px | 50%;
  block-size:             auto | 100px | 50%;
  border:                 shorthand;
  border-block:           1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-collapse:        separate | collapse;
  border-color:           var(--c-border);
  border-image:           url() slice / width / outset repeat;
  border-inline:          1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius:          var(--r-xl) | 50% | 8px 4px 4px 8px;
  border-style:           solid | dashed | dotted | double | none;
  border-width:           1px | thin | medium | thick;
  bottom:                 auto | 0 | 100px;
  box-decoration-break:   slice | clone;
  box-shadow:             0 4px 8px oklch(0% 0 0 / 10%) | inset 0 0 0;
  box-sizing:             content-box | border-box;
  break-after:            auto | avoid | page | column;
  break-before:           auto | avoid | page | column;
  break-inside:           auto | avoid | avoid-page | avoid-column;

  /* ─── C ─── */
  caption-side:           top | bottom;
  caret-color:            auto | var(--c-accent);
  clear:                  none | left | right | both | inline-start | inline-end;
  clip-path:              none | circle() | ellipse() | polygon() | inset() | path();
  color:                  inherit | oklch(55% 0.22 260);
  color-scheme:           normal | light | dark | light dark | only light;
  column-count:           auto | 3;
  column-fill:            balance | auto;
  column-gap:             normal | 1rem;
  column-rule:            1px solid var(--c-border);
  column-span:            none | all;
  column-width:           auto | 200px;
  contain:                none | strict | content | size | layout | paint | style;
  contain-intrinsic-size: none | auto 300px;
  content:                normal | none | '' | attr() | counter() | open-quote;
  content-visibility:     visible | hidden | auto;
  counter-increment:      name 1;
  counter-reset:          name 0;
  counter-set:            name 5;
  cursor:                 auto | default | pointer | grab | grabbing | text | crosshair | wait | not-allowed | zoom-in | none;

  /* ─── D ─── */
  direction:              ltr | rtl;
  display:                block | inline | flex | grid | inline-flex | inline-grid | none | contents | table | list-item | flow-root;

  /* ─── F ─── */
  field-sizing:           fixed | content;
  filter:                 none | blur() | brightness() | contrast() | drop-shadow() | grayscale() | hue-rotate() | invert() | opacity() | saturate() | sepia();
  flex:                   0 1 auto | 1 | none | auto;
  flex-basis:             auto | 0 | 200px | 50%;
  flex-direction:         row | row-reverse | column | column-reverse;
  flex-flow:              row nowrap;
  flex-grow:              0 | 1;
  flex-shrink:            1 | 0;
  flex-wrap:              nowrap | wrap | wrap-reverse;
  float:                  none | left | right | inline-start | inline-end;
  font:                   shorthand;
  font-family:            system-ui | 'Inter' | serif | sans-serif | monospace;
  font-feature-settings:  normal | 'liga' 1 | 'tnum' 1;
  font-kerning:           auto | normal | none;
  font-language-override: normal;
  font-optical-sizing:    auto | none;
  font-palette:           normal | dark | light | --custom;
  font-size:              1rem | clamp() | medium | large;
  font-size-adjust:       none | 0.5 | ex-height from-font;
  font-stretch:           normal | condensed | expanded | 85%;
  font-style:             normal | italic | oblique 12deg;
  font-synthesis:         none | weight style small-caps;
  font-variant:           shorthand;
  font-variant-caps:      normal | small-caps | all-small-caps;
  font-variant-numeric:   normal | oldstyle-nums | tabular-nums | lining-nums;
  font-variation-settings: normal | 'wght' 650;
  font-weight:            400 | bold | 100..900;
  forced-color-adjust:    auto | none;

  /* ─── G ─── */
  gap:                    0 | 1rem | 1rem 2rem;
  grid:                   shorthand;
  grid-area:              name | 1 / 2 / 3 / 4;
  grid-auto-columns:      auto | 1fr | minmax(100px, 1fr);
  grid-auto-flow:         row | column | row dense | column dense;
  grid-auto-rows:         auto | 1fr | 100px;
  grid-column:            1 / 3 | span 2 | 1 / -1;
  grid-row:               1 / 3 | span 2;
  grid-template:          shorthand;
  grid-template-areas:    'header' 'main' 'footer';
  grid-template-columns:  1fr 2fr | repeat(3, 1fr) | subgrid;
  grid-template-rows:     auto 1fr auto | repeat(3, 100px) | subgrid;

  /* ─── H ─── */
  hanging-punctuation:    none | first | last | allow-end | force-end;
  height:                 auto | 100px | 50% | 100dvh | fit-content;
  hyphenate-limit-chars:  auto | 6 3 2;
  hyphens:                none | manual | auto;

  /* ─── I ─── */
  image-rendering:        auto | smooth | crisp-edges | pixelated;
  inline-size:            auto | 100% | 200px;
  inset:                  0 | auto | 10px 20px;
  inset-block:            0 | auto;
  inset-inline:           0 | auto;
  interpolate-size:       numeric-only | allow-keywords;
  isolation:              auto | isolate;

  /* ─── J ─── */
  justify-content:        normal | flex-start | flex-end | center | space-between | space-around | space-evenly;
  justify-items:          normal | start | end | center | stretch;
  justify-self:           auto | start | end | center | stretch;

  /* ─── L ─── */
  left:                   auto | 0 | 100px;
  letter-spacing:         normal | 0.05em | -0.02em;
  line-break:             auto | loose | normal | strict | anywhere;
  line-height:            normal | 1.5 | 24px;
  list-style:             none | disc outside;

  /* ─── M ─── */
  margin:                 0 | auto | 1rem 2rem;
  margin-block:           0 | 1rem;
  margin-inline:          auto | 0;
  mask:                   shorthand;
  mask-image:             none | url() | linear-gradient();
  max-block-size:         none | 100%;
  max-height:             none | 100px | 80dvh;
  max-inline-size:        none | 65ch;
  max-width:              none | 1280px | 100%;
  min-block-size:         0 | auto;
  min-height:             0 | 100dvh;
  min-inline-size:        0 | 200px;
  min-width:              0 | 200px | min-content;
  mix-blend-mode:         normal | multiply | screen | overlay;

  /* ─── O ─── */
  object-fit:             fill | contain | cover | none | scale-down;
  object-position:        center | top right | 50% 20%;
  offset:                 shorthand (motion path);
  opacity:                0..1;
  order:                  0 | -1 | 5;
  orphans:                2 | 3;
  outline:                2px solid var(--c-accent);
  outline-offset:         0 | 2px | -2px;
  overflow:               visible | hidden | clip | scroll | auto;
  overflow-anchor:        auto | none;
  overflow-clip-margin:   0 | 16px;
  overflow-wrap:          normal | break-word | anywhere;
  overscroll-behavior:    auto | contain | none;

  /* ─── P ─── */
  padding:                0 | 1rem | 1rem 2rem;
  padding-block:          0 | 1rem;
  padding-inline:         0 | 1rem;
  paint-order:            normal | fill stroke markers;
  perspective:            none | 800px;
  perspective-origin:     50% 50% | center;
  place-content:          shorthand (align-content + justify-content);
  place-items:            shorthand;
  place-self:             shorthand;
  pointer-events:         auto | none | visible | all;
  position:               static | relative | absolute | fixed | sticky;

  /* ─── Q ─── */
  quotes:                 none | '"' '"' "'" "'";

  /* ─── R ─── */
  resize:                 none | both | horizontal | vertical | block | inline;
  rotate:                 none | 45deg | 0.25turn;
  row-gap:                0 | 1rem;

  /* ─── S ─── */
  scale:                  none | 1 | 1.5 | 1.2 0.8;
  scroll-behavior:        auto | smooth;
  scroll-margin:          0 | 1rem;
  scroll-padding:         0 | 1rem;
  scroll-snap-align:      none | start | end | center;
  scroll-snap-stop:       normal | always;
  scroll-snap-type:       none | x mandatory | y proximity | both mandatory;
  scrollbar-color:        auto | thumb track;
  scrollbar-gutter:       auto | stable | stable both-edges;
  scrollbar-width:        auto | thin | none;
  shape-image-threshold:  0 | 0.5 | 1;
  shape-margin:           0 | 1rem;
  shape-outside:          none | circle() | polygon() | url();

  /* ─── T ─── */
  tab-size:               8 | 2 | 4;
  table-layout:           auto | fixed;
  text-align:             start | end | left | right | center | justify;
  text-combine-upright:   none | all | digits 2;
  text-decoration:        none | underline | overline | line-through;
  text-emphasis:          none | '•' oklch(55% 0.22 260);
  text-indent:            0 | 2em;
  text-orientation:       mixed | upright | sideways;
  text-overflow:          clip | ellipsis;
  text-shadow:            none | 0 2px 4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 20%);
  text-transform:         none | capitalize | uppercase | lowercase | full-width;
  text-underline-offset:  auto | 0.2em;
  text-wrap:              wrap | nowrap | balance | pretty | stable;
  top:                    auto | 0 | 100px;
  touch-action:           auto | none | pan-x | pan-y | manipulation;
  transform:              none | translate() | scale() | rotate();
  transform-box:          content-box | border-box | fill-box | view-box;
  transform-origin:       50% 50% | center | top left;
  transform-style:        flat | preserve-3d;
  transition:             all 0.3s ease | property duration timing delay;
  translate:              none | 0 10px | 50%;

  /* ─── U ─── */
  unicode-bidi:           normal | embed | isolate | bidi-override;
  user-select:            auto | none | text | all | contain;

  /* ─── V ─── */
  vertical-align:         baseline | top | middle | bottom | text-top | text-bottom | super | sub;
  view-transition-name:   none | identifier;
  visibility:             visible | hidden | collapse;

  /* ─── W ─── */
  white-space:            normal | nowrap | pre | pre-wrap | pre-line | break-spaces;
  widows:                 2 | 3;
  width:                  auto | 100% | 200px | fit-content | min-content | max-content;
  will-change:            auto | transform | opacity | scroll-position;
  word-break:             normal | break-all | keep-all | break-word;
  word-spacing:           normal | 0.1em;
  writing-mode:           horizontal-tb | vertical-rl | vertical-lr | sideways-rl;

  /* ─── Z ─── */
  z-index:                auto | 0 | 100 | -1;
}
```

# CSS GUIDE — PART 26
## Chapters 374–395

## 374. CSS ДЛЯ COMMAND PALETTE И QUICK ACTIONS

```css
/* ─── Command Palette (Spotlight / ⌘K) ─── */
.command-palette-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 50%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  z-index: var(--z-modal);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 15vh;
}

.command-palette {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 580px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: cmd-appear 0.2s var(--ease-out) both;
}

@keyframes cmd-appear {
  from { opacity: 0; scale: 0.96; translate: 0 -12px; }
}

/* Search input */
.cmd-search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  z-index: 1;
}

.cmd-search-icon {
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 18px; height: 18px;
}

.cmd-input {
  flex: 1;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}

.cmd-close-key {
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 2px var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Results list */
.cmd-results {
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-height: 400px;
  padding: var(--s-2);
}

.cmd-group-label {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3) var(--s-1);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
}

.cmd-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &.active,
  &:hover {
    background: var(--c-accent-sub);
    color: var(--c-accent);

    .cmd-item-shortcut { color: var(--c-accent); }
    .cmd-item-icon { color: var(--c-accent); }
  }
}

.cmd-item-icon {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.cmd-item-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.cmd-item-label { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
.cmd-item-desc  { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--c-text-muted); }

.cmd-item-shortcut {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.shortcut-key {
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 1px var(--s-1-5);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  min-width: 18px;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Highlight match */
.cmd-item-label mark {
  background: oklch(90% 0.20 85 / 50%);
  color: inherit;
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
}

/* Footer */
.cmd-footer {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  align-items: center;
}

.cmd-footer-hint {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

/* Empty state */
.cmd-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-8);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}
```

## 375. CSS ДЛЯ ПАНЕЛЕЙ ИНСПЕКТОРА И SIDE DRAWER

```css
/* ─── Side Panel / Drawer ─── */
.drawer-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 40%);
  z-index: calc(var(--z-overlay) - 1);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.drawer-overlay.open {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: var(--drawer-width, 360px);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  z-index: var(--z-overlay);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: translate 0.35s var(--ease-out);
}

/* Right drawer */
.drawer-right {
  right: 0;
  border-right: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl) 0 0 var(--r-2xl);
  translate: 100% 0;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
}

.drawer-right.open { translate: 0 0; }

/* Left drawer */
.drawer-left {
  left: 0;
  border-left: none;
  border-radius: 0 var(--r-2xl) var(--r-2xl) 0;
  translate: -100% 0;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
}

.drawer-left.open { translate: 0 0; }

/* Bottom sheet */
.drawer-bottom {
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0; right: 0;
  top: auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 90dvh;
  border-radius: var(--r-3xl) var(--r-3xl) 0 0;
  border-bottom: none;
  translate: 0 100%;
}

.drawer-bottom.open { translate: 0 0; }

/* Handle for bottom sheet */
.drawer-handle {
  width: 40px; height: 4px;
  background: var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  margin: var(--s-3) auto;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.drawer-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.drawer-title {
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
}

.drawer-close {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  font-size: 1.2rem;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
}

.drawer-body {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--s-5);
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

.drawer-footer {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  padding-bottom: max(var(--s-4), env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0));
}

/* ─── Inspector Panel (like DevTools) ─── */
.inspector {
  width: 320px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.inspector-tabs {
  display: flex;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.inspector-tab {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: color 0.1s;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;

  &.active { color: var(--c-accent); border-bottom-color: var(--c-accent); }
  &:hover  { color: var(--c-text); }
}

.inspector-section {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.inspector-section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  user-select: none;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-border); }
}

.inspector-toggle { transition: rotate 0.2s; }
.inspector-section.collapsed .inspector-toggle { rotate: -90deg; }
.inspector-section.collapsed .inspector-body { display: none; }

.inspector-body { padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4); }

.inspector-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) 0;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  align-items: baseline;
}

.inspector-label {
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.inspector-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  word-break: break-all;
  cursor: text;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 1px var(--s-1);
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

/* Color swatch in inspector */
.inspector-color {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

.color-chip {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  border: 1px solid oklch(0% 0 0 / 20%);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
```

## 376. CSS ДЛЯ NOTIFICATION CENTER

```css
/* ─── Notification Center ─── */
.notif-center {
  position: fixed;
  top: calc(var(--header-h, 56px) + var(--s-2));
  right: var(--s-4);
  width: 380px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  z-index: var(--z-modal);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 80px);
}

.notif-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.notif-title { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); font-size: var(--text-base); }

.notif-actions-header {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.notif-action-link {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);

  &:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
}

/* Tabs */
.notif-tabs {
  display: flex;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.notif-tab {
  flex: 1;
  padding: var(--s-2-5);
  text-align: center;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);

  &.active { color: var(--c-accent); border-bottom-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

/* Notification List */
.notif-list {
  overflow-y: auto;
  flex: 1;
}

.notif-group-date {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-5) var(--s-1);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  z-index: 1;
}

.notif-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  position: relative;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.unread { background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
  &.unread:hover { background: oklch(from var(--c-accent-sub) l c h / 0.8); }
}

/* Unread dot */
.notif-item.unread::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--s-2);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
}

.notif-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  position: relative;
}

.notif-type-icon {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -2px; right: -2px;
  width: 18px; height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-surface);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 10px;
}

.notif-type-like    { background: oklch(60% 0.22 15); color: white; }
.notif-type-comment { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
.notif-type-mention { background: var(--c-warning); color: oklch(15% 0 0); }
.notif-type-system  { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }

.notif-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.notif-text {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.notif-text strong { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); }

.notif-time {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--s-0-5);
}

.notif-media {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.notif-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

/* Notification actions */
.notif-item-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  margin-top: var(--s-2);
}

.notif-btn {
  padding: var(--s-1) var(--s-2-5);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &.primary { background: var(--c-accent); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
  &:hover   { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.primary:hover { background: var(--c-accent-h); }
}

/* Empty state */
.notif-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-12) var(--s-8);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.notif-empty-icon { font-size: 3rem; }
```

## 377. CSS ДЛЯ OTP / PIN INPUT

```css
/* ─── OTP / PIN Code Input ─── */
.otp-input {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2-5);
  justify-content: center;
}

.otp-digit {
  width: 52px;
  height: 60px;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--c-text);
  outline: none;
  caret-color: var(--c-accent);
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: 0;

  /* Скрыть стрелки */
  -moz-appearance: textfield;
  appearance: textfield;

  &::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
  &::-webkit-inner-spin-button { display: none; }

  &:focus {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-accent-sub);
  }

  &.filled {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  }

  &.error {
    border-color: var(--c-danger);
    background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.05);
    animation: shake 0.4s ease;
  }
}

@keyframes shake {
  0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; }
  20%, 60%  { translate: -4px 0; }
  40%, 80%  { translate:  4px 0; }
}

/* OTP separator */
.otp-sep {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
}

/* Compact OTP */
.otp-compact .otp-digit {
  width: 40px;
  height: 48px;
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
}

/* ─── Credit Card Input ─── */
.card-input-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  max-width: 380px;
}

.card-preview {
  aspect-ratio: 85.6 / 53.98; /* credit card ratio */
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent), oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c calc(h+40)));
  padding: var(--s-5) var(--s-6);
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
}

.card-preview::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -20%; right: -10%;
  width: 200px; height: 200px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 10%);
}

.card-chip {
  width: 40px; height: 30px;
  background: oklch(80% 0.10 85);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px;
}

.card-chip-cell {
  background: oklch(70% 0.10 85);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.card-number-preview {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.card-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  opacity: 0.8;
}

/* Card number field */
.card-number-field {
  position: relative;
}

.card-brand-icon {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--s-3);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  height: 24px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Expiry + CVV row */
.card-row-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

/* ─── Phone Number Input ─── */
.phone-input {
  display: flex;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;

  &:focus-within {
    border-color: var(--c-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--c-accent-sub);
  }
}

.phone-country {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.phone-flag { font-size: 1.2em; }
.phone-code { color: var(--c-text-muted); }

.phone-number {
  flex: 1;
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text);
  min-width: 0;

  &::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}
```
