## 378. CSS ДЛЯ СЛОЖНЫХ ИНПУТОВ — COLOR PICKER, SIGNATURE

```css
/* ─── Color Picker ─── */
.color-picker {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  width: 260px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

/* Saturation/Value gradient square */
.color-sv-box {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: crosshair;
  /* JS draws gradient via canvas or gradient CSS */
  background:
    linear-gradient(to top, black, transparent),
    linear-gradient(to right, white, oklch(60% 0.35 var(--hue, 0)));
}

.color-cursor {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px; height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 30%), 0 2px 6px oklch(0% 0 0 / 40%);
  translate: -50% -50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  top: var(--cursor-y, 20%);
  left: var(--cursor-x, 80%);
}

/* Hue slider */
.color-hue-slider {
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  background: linear-gradient(to right,
    oklch(60% 0.35 0),
    oklch(60% 0.35 30),
    oklch(60% 0.35 60),
    oklch(60% 0.35 90),
    oklch(60% 0.35 120),
    oklch(60% 0.35 150),
    oklch(60% 0.35 180),
    oklch(60% 0.35 210),
    oklch(60% 0.35 240),
    oklch(60% 0.35 270),
    oklch(60% 0.35 300),
    oklch(60% 0.35 330),
    oklch(60% 0.35 360)
  );
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.slider-thumb {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: var(--pos, 0%);
  translate: -50% -50%;
  width: 18px; height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: white;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 20%), 0 2px 4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 30%);
  cursor: grab;
  pointer-events: none;

  &:active { cursor: grabbing; }
}

/* Alpha slider */
.color-alpha-slider {
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--color, oklch(55% 0.22 260))),
    repeating-conic-gradient(oklch(80% 0 0) 0deg 90deg, oklch(90% 0 0) 90deg 180deg);
  background-size: auto, 10px 10px;
}

/* Swatches */
.color-swatches {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

.color-swatch {
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color 0.1s, scale 0.1s;

  &:hover  { scale: 1.2; }
  &.active { border-color: white; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--c-text); }
}

/* Input row */
.color-inputs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  align-items: center;
}

.color-preview-swatch {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.color-hex-input {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ─── Signature Pad ─── */
.signature-pad {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.signature-canvas-wrap {
  position: relative;
  border: 2px dashed var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg,
      transparent,
      transparent 24px,
      oklch(80% 0 0 / 30%) 24px,
      oklch(80% 0 0 / 30%) 25px
    );
  background-color: var(--c-surface);
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: crosshair;
  touch-action: none;
}

.signature-canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 160px;
}

.signature-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--s-3);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  user-select: none;
  pointer-events: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.signature-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

/* Drawing mode indicator */
.signature-canvas-wrap.drawing {
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  cursor: crosshair;
}

.signature-canvas-wrap.has-signature {
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: var(--c-border);
}
```

## 379. CSS ДЛЯ SPLIT VIEW И DIFF

```css
/* ─── Split View ─── */
.split-view {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr var(--divider-width, 4px) 1fr;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.split-pane {
  overflow: auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* Resizable divider */
.split-divider {
  background: var(--c-border);
  cursor: col-resize;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.15s;

  &:hover, &.dragging { background: var(--c-accent); }
}

.split-divider::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset-block: 0;
  inset-inline: -4px;
  /* Expand hit area */
}

.divider-handle {
  width: 20px; height: 32px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-sm);
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.divider-dot {
  width: 4px; height: 4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
}

/* ─── Code Diff View ─── */
.diff-view {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow: auto;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
}

.diff-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-height: 1.6em;

  &:hover { background: oklch(from var(--c-muted) l c h / 0.5); }
}

.diff-gutter {
  min-width: 48px;
  padding: 0 var(--s-3);
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  user-select: none;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.diff-sign {
  width: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
}

.diff-content {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 0 var(--s-3);
  white-space: pre;
}

/* Diff types */
.diff-line.added {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-success) l c h / 0.08);
  .diff-sign   { color: var(--c-success); }
  .diff-content { color: var(--c-text); }
}

.diff-line.removed {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.08);
  .diff-sign   { color: var(--c-danger); }
  .diff-content { text-decoration: line-through; color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}

.diff-line.context { color: var(--c-text-muted); }

.diff-line.hunk-header {
  background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.05);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Inline diff highlights */
.diff-word-added   { background: oklch(from var(--c-success) l c h / 0.3); border-radius: 2px; }
.diff-word-removed { background: oklch(from var(--c-danger) l c h / 0.3); border-radius: 2px; }

/* Side-by-side diff */
.diff-side-by-side {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0;
}

.diff-panel {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);

  &:last-child { border-right: none; }
}

.diff-panel-header {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}
```

## 380. CSS ДЛЯ READING MODE И FOCUS MODE

```css
/* ─── Reading Mode ─── */
body.reading-mode {
  background: oklch(97% 0.01 85); /* тёплый белый */
  color: oklch(15% 0 0);
}

body.reading-mode.dark {
  background: oklch(12% 0.01 260);
  color: oklch(88% 0 0);
}

.reading-content {
  max-width: 68ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: var(--s-12) var(--s-6);
  font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino', serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: inherit;
}

.reading-content h1 { font-size: 2em; line-height: 1.2; margin-block: 1.5em 0.75em; }
.reading-content h2 { font-size: 1.5em; margin-block: 1.5em 0.5em; }
.reading-content p  { margin-block-end: 1.25em; hyphens: auto; orphans: 3; widows: 3; }

/* Reading mode toolbar */
.reading-toolbar {
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--s-4);
  right: var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  z-index: var(--z-fixed);
}

body.reading-mode:hover .reading-toolbar,
body.reading-mode .reading-toolbar:focus-within {
  opacity: 1;
}

.reading-control {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; border-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

/* Font size control */
.font-size-control {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

/* Progress indicator */
.reading-progress-bar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  z-index: var(--z-top);
}

.reading-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  width: var(--reading-progress, 0%);
  transition: width 0.1s linear;
}

/* ─── Focus Mode (distraction-free writing) ─── */
.focus-mode {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--c-bg);
  z-index: var(--z-modal);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-8);
}

.focus-editor {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 700px;
  min-height: 60vh;
  font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--c-text);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  resize: none;
  caret-color: var(--c-accent);

  &::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-muted); opacity: 0.5; }
}

/* Word count in focus mode */
.focus-stats {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--s-6);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);
}

/* ─── Sepia / Night reading themes ─── */
[data-theme="sepia"] {
  --c-bg:       oklch(93% 0.04 80);
  --c-surface:  oklch(95% 0.04 80);
  --c-text:     oklch(25% 0.05 60);
  --c-muted:    oklch(88% 0.04 80);
  --c-border:   oklch(82% 0.04 80);
}

[data-theme="night"] {
  --c-bg:       oklch(8% 0.01 260);
  --c-surface:  oklch(12% 0.01 260);
  --c-text:     oklch(78% 0.01 260);
  --c-muted:    oklch(15% 0.01 260);
  --c-border:   oklch(20% 0.01 260);
}

/* Eye comfort: warm overlay for night mode */
[data-theme="night"]::after {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(50% 0.15 60 / 3%); /* warm tint */
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--z-top);
}
```

## 381. CSS ДЛЯ ПЕЧАТНЫХ ДОКУМЕНТОВ

```css
/* ─── Invoice / Receipt Print ─── */
@media print {
  @page {
    size: A4;
    margin: 15mm 20mm;
  }

  @page :first {
    margin-top: 25mm;
  }

  body {
    font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
    font-size: 10pt;
    color: black;
    background: white;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
  }
}

/* Invoice layout */
.invoice-doc {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 40px;
  font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11pt;
  color: #333;
}

/* Header */
.inv-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #000;
}

.inv-logo { font-size: 24pt; font-weight: bold; color: #000; }
.inv-logo-sub { font-size: 9pt; color: #666; margin-top: 2px; }

.inv-badge {
  text-align: right;
}

.inv-title {
  font-size: 22pt;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #000;
}

.inv-number { font-size: 10pt; color: #666; margin-top: 4px; }

/* Parties */
.inv-parties {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.inv-party-label {
  font-size: 8pt;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: #999;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.inv-party-name { font-weight: bold; font-size: 12pt; }
.inv-party-address { font-size: 10pt; color: #444; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 4px; }

/* Line items table */
.inv-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 10pt;
}

.inv-table thead tr {
  background: #000;
  color: white;
  -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
  print-color-adjust: exact;
}

.inv-table th {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 9pt;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.inv-table th:last-child,
.inv-table td:last-child { text-align: right; }

.inv-table td {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
}

.inv-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: #f8f8f8;
  -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
  print-color-adjust: exact;
}

/* Totals */
.inv-totals {
  width: 280px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.inv-total-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 6px 0;
  font-size: 10pt;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
}

.inv-total-row:last-child {
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 12pt;
  border-bottom: none;
  border-top: 2px solid #000;
  padding-top: 10px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

/* Footer */
.inv-footer {
  margin-top: 40px;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid #ccc;
  font-size: 9pt;
  color: #666;
  text-align: center;
}

.inv-terms {
  font-size: 9pt;
  color: #666;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 12px;
  background: #f5f5f5;
  border-left: 3px solid #000;
  -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
}

/* ─── Receipt (narrow) ─── */
@media print {
  @page.receipt { size: 80mm auto; margin: 5mm; }
}

.receipt-doc {
  width: 80mm;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  font-size: 9pt;
  padding: 5mm;
}

.receipt-center { text-align: center; }
.receipt-header { border-bottom: 1px dashed black; padding-bottom: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; }
.receipt-item   { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
.receipt-total  { border-top: 2px solid black; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11pt; padding-top: 4pt; }
.receipt-footer { border-top: 1px dashed black; margin-top: 6pt; padding-top: 6pt; font-size: 8pt; }
```

## 382. CSS ДЛЯ MAP ИНТЕРФЕЙСОВ

```css
/* ─── Map Container ─── */
.map-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 500px;
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.map-element {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  /* Leaflet/Mapbox/Google Maps заполняет этот контейнер */
}

/* ─── Map Controls (custom) ─── */
.map-controls {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-4);
  right: var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  z-index: 10;
}

.map-btn {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-sm);
  color: var(--c-text);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }
}

/* ─── Search on map ─── */
.map-search {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-4);
  left: var(--s-4);
  width: 280px;
  z-index: 10;
}

.map-search-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-lg);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  outline: none;

  &:focus { border-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

/* ─── Map Marker ─── */
.map-marker {
  position: absolute;
  translate: -50% -100%; /* anchor to bottom-center */
  width: 32px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px oklch(0% 0 0 / 30%));
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: scale 0.2s var(--ease-spring);

  &:hover { scale: 1.2; }
}

/* CSS-only marker pin */
.marker-pin {
  width: 24px; height: 34px;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
  border-radius: var(--r-full) var(--r-full) var(--r-full) var(--r-full) / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.4);
}

.marker-pin::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -8px;
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--c-accent);
  border-bottom: none;
}

/* ─── Info Popup ─── */
.map-popup {
  position: absolute;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  width: 240px;
  z-index: 20;
  animation: popup-in 0.2s var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes popup-in {
  from { opacity: 0; scale: 0.9; translate: 0 8px; }
}

.map-popup::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -8px; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  border: 8px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--c-surface);
  border-bottom: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 var(--c-border));
}

/* ─── Map Legend ─── */
.map-legend {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--s-4);
  left: var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-md);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: 2px 0;
}

.legend-color {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ─── Map Cluster ─── */
.map-cluster {
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border: 3px solid white;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: scale 0.2s;

  &:hover { scale: 1.1; }
}

/* Cluster size variants */
.map-cluster.small  { width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: var(--text-xs); }
.map-cluster.medium { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.map-cluster.large  { width: 52px; height: 52px; font-size: var(--text-lg); background: var(--c-danger); }
```

## 383. CSS ДЛЯ RICH TEXT ПРОСМОТРА — EMAIL VIEWER

```css
/* ─── Email Viewer ─── */
.email-viewer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr;
  height: 100dvh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--c-surface);
}

/* Email list */
.email-list {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.email-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;
  position: relative;

  &:hover   { background: var(--c-muted); }
  &.active  { background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
  &.unread  { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); }
}

.email-item.unread::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--s-2);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  width: 5px; height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
}

.email-item-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.email-sender  { font-size: var(--text-sm); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.email-time    { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--c-text-muted); flex-shrink: 0; }
.email-subject { font-size: var(--text-sm); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.email-preview { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--c-text-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: normal; }

/* Email reading pane */
.email-pane {
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.email-pane-header {
  padding: var(--s-5) var(--s-6);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  z-index: 1;
}

.email-subject-line {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-4);
}

.email-metadata {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.email-meta-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  align-items: baseline;
}

.email-meta-label {
  min-width: 50px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

/* Email body */
.email-body {
  padding: var(--s-6);
  flex: 1;
}

/* Quote block */
.email-quote {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-border);
  padding-left: var(--s-4);
  margin-left: 0;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

/* Attachment */
.email-attachments {
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-6);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.attachment {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-border); }
}

.attachment-icon { font-size: var(--text-base); }
.attachment-name { font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
.attachment-size { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
```

## 384. CSS ДЛЯ PHOTO EDITOR UI

```css
/* ─── Photo Editor Layout ─── */
.photo-editor {
  display: grid;
  grid-template:
    "toolbar toolbar" auto
    "canvas  panels"  1fr
    / 1fr 280px;
  height: 100dvh;
  background: oklch(12% 0 0);
  color: oklch(85% 0 0);
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Toolbar */
.editor-toolbar {
  grid-area: toolbar;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4);
  background: oklch(18% 0 0);
  border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(25% 0 0);
}

/* Canvas area */
.editor-canvas-area {
  grid-area: canvas;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  cursor: crosshair;
}

/* Checkerboard for transparency */
.editor-canvas-area::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    repeating-conic-gradient(oklch(20% 0 0) 0deg 90deg, oklch(15% 0 0) 90deg 180deg);
  background-size: 20px 20px;
}

.editor-canvas {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(40% 0 0), var(--sh-xl);
}

/* Tool strips */
.tool-strip {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  padding: var(--s-3);
  background: oklch(18% 0 0);
  border-right: 1px solid oklch(25% 0 0);
}

.tool-btn {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: oklch(70% 0 0);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover  { background: oklch(25% 0 0); color: oklch(90% 0 0); }
  &.active { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
}

/* Panels sidebar */
.editor-panels {
  grid-area: panels;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: oklch(18% 0 0);
  border-left: 1px solid oklch(25% 0 0);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* Filter panel */
.filter-panel { padding: var(--s-4); }

.filter-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: oklch(55% 0 0);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-2);
}

.filter-slider {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: var(--c-accent);
}

.filter-value {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: oklch(65% 0 0);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  min-width: 36px;
  text-align: end;
}

.filter-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2) 0;
}

/* Histogram */
.histogram {
  height: 60px;
  background: oklch(10% 0 0);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1px;
  padding: 0 2px;
}

.histogram-bar {
  flex: 1;
  background: oklch(55% 0 0);
  border-radius: 1px 1px 0 0;
  min-height: 2px;
}

/* Layers panel */
.layers-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
}

.layer-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover  { background: oklch(25% 0 0); }
  &.active { background: oklch(30% 0.05 260); }
}

.layer-thumb {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  border: 1px solid oklch(30% 0 0);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background:
    repeating-conic-gradient(oklch(20% 0 0) 0deg 90deg, oklch(15% 0 0) 90deg 180deg);
  background-size: 8px 8px;
}

.layer-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.layer-name {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.layer-visibility {
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: oklch(60% 0 0);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
```

## 385. СВЕРХ-ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ ИТОГ

```css
/*
  ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CSS GUIDE 2025 — АБСОЛЮТНЫЙ ФИНАЛ
  
  Главы: 385+
  Строк: ~68 000+
  Размер: ~1.85 МБ
  
  ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ВСЕ ПОКРЫТЫЕ ТЕМЫ:
  
  ОСНОВЫ И АРХИТЕКТУРА
  ▸ Каскад, специфичность, наследование
  ▸ Блочная модель, форматирование контекстов
  ▸ @layer, @property, CSS Nesting
  ▸ Custom Properties — полная система
  ▸ Design Tokens — 3-уровневая архитектура
  
  LAYOUT
  ▸ Flexbox — все свойства и паттерны
  ▸ CSS Grid — все свойства и паттерны
  ▸ Subgrid — практический разбор
  ▸ Multi-column, Fragmentation
  ▸ Container Queries (size + style + state)
  ▸ 30+ layout паттернов для production
  
  ЦВЕТ И ТИПОГРАФИКА
  ▸ oklch — полный разбор и палитры
  ▸ color-mix(), relative colors, light-dark()
  ▸ P3, Display P3, color-gamut
  ▸ Font face, variable fonts, OpenType
  ▸ text-wrap: balance/pretty, fluid typography
  ▸ text effects, drop cap, print typography
  
  АНИМАЦИИ И ПЕРЕХОДЫ
  ▸ @keyframes — полный разбор
  ▸ Transitions — координация, stagger
  ▸ Scroll-Driven Animations
  ▸ View Transitions (same + cross-document)
  ▸ @starting-style + allow-discrete
  ▸ 3D Transforms — полный разбор
  ▸ Animation performance
  
  СОВРЕМЕННЫЕ ФИЧИ
  ▸ :has() — 20+ паттернов
  ▸ :is() / :where() — специфичность
  ▸ Anchor Positioning
  ▸ CSS Scroll Markers
  ▸ @scope, @layer advanced
  ▸ interpolate-size, calc-size()
  ▸ field-sizing: content
  ▸ CSS Houdini (Paint Worklet, @property)
  
  ДОСТУПНОСТЬ
  ▸ :focus-visible — система
  ▸ forced-colors / High Contrast Mode
  ▸ prefers-* медиа-запросы
  ▸ ARIA + CSS паттерны
  ▸ Logical Properties (RTL/LTR)
  
  ПРОИЗВОДИТЕЛЬНОСТЬ
  ▸ contain, content-visibility
  ▸ GPU compositing, will-change
  ▸ CSS профилирование
  ▸ Layout thrashing prevention
  ▸ Critical CSS
  
  UI КОМПОНЕНТЫ (60+)
  ▸ Button, Card, Form, Table
  ▸ Modal, Dialog, Drawer
  ▸ Dropdown, Tooltip, Popover
  ▸ Tabs, Accordion, Pagination
  ▸ Navigation (top, sidebar, bottom, mega)
  ▸ Toast, Alert, Badge
  ▸ Loading (skeleton, spinner, progress)
  ▸ Chat, Feed, Profile
  ▸ Calendar, Date Picker
  ▸ Kanban, Gantt, Spreadsheet
  ▸ Audio/Video Player
  ▸ File Manager, Code Viewer
  ▸ Command Palette, Inspector
  ▸ OTP Input, Color Picker, Signature
  ▸ Map UI, Email Viewer
  ▸ Photo Editor, AI Chat
  ▸ Pricing, Gallery, Lightbox
  ▸ Landing Page, Documentation
  ▸ Settings, Profile, Onboarding
  
  СПЕЦИАЛИЗАЦИЯ
  ▸ PWA, Safe Areas, Offline UI
  ▸ Print CSS, Invoice, Receipt
  ▸ Email CSS (клиентские ограничения)
  ▸ Game UI (HUD, inventory, minimap)
  ▸ Reading Mode, Focus Mode
  ▸ Foldable / Dual Screen
  ▸ Large Screen / TV / 4K
```

## 386. CSS ДЛЯ СРАВНЕНИЯ ИЗОБРАЖЕНИЙ (BEFORE/AFTER SLIDER)

```css
/* ─── Image Comparison Slider ─── */
.img-compare {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  cursor: ew-resize;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.img-compare-before,
.img-compare-after {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}

.img-compare-before img,
.img-compare-after img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* After image clipped */
.img-compare-after {
  clip-path: inset(0 0 0 var(--pos, 50%));
  transition: clip-path 0s; /* no transition during drag */
}

/* Divider line */
.img-compare-divider {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; bottom: 0;
  left: var(--pos, 50%);
  translate: -50% 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: white;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px oklch(0% 0 0 / 40%);
}

/* Drag handle */
.img-compare-handle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: var(--pos, 50%);
  translate: -50% -50%;
  width: 48px; height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: white;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px oklch(0% 0 0 / 30%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 3;
  cursor: ew-resize;
  transition: scale 0.15s;

  &:hover { scale: 1.1; }
  &:active { scale: 0.95; }
}

.handle-arrows {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  color: oklch(40% 0 0);
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* Labels */
.img-compare-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 60%);
  color: white;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.label-before { left: var(--s-4); }
.label-after  { right: var(--s-4); }

/* Animated introduction */
@keyframes compare-reveal {
  0%   { --pos: 80%; }
  50%  { --pos: 20%; }
  100% { --pos: 50%; }
}

.img-compare.animate {
  animation: compare-reveal 2s ease-in-out forwards;
}

/* Touch support */
.img-compare {
  touch-action: none;
}
```

## 387. CSS ДЛЯ РЕЙТИНГОВЫХ СИСТЕМ

```css
/* ─── Star Rating ─── */
.rating {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  align-items: center;
}

/* Interactive stars */
.rating-interactive {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row-reverse; /* trick for :hover fill effect */
  gap: 0;
}

.rating-star-input {
  appearance: none;
  display: none;
}

.rating-star-label {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: var(--c-border);
  transition: color 0.1s, scale 0.1s;
  padding: 0 2px;
}

/* Fill stars on hover (using row-reverse + CSS siblings) */
.rating-interactive .rating-star-label:hover,
.rating-interactive .rating-star-label:hover ~ .rating-star-label {
  color: oklch(75% 0.20 85);
  scale: 1.1;
}

/* Fill selected and previous */
.rating-interactive input:checked ~ label {
  color: oklch(75% 0.20 85);
}

/* Static display stars */
.stars-static {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1px;
  position: relative;
}

.stars-empty {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1px;
  color: var(--c-border);
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.stars-filled {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1px;
  color: oklch(75% 0.20 85);
  font-size: 1rem;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: calc(var(--rating, 0) / var(--max, 5) * 100%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ─── Horizontal bar rating (breakdown) ─── */
.rating-breakdown {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.rating-bar-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  align-items: center;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.rating-bar-label { white-space: nowrap; color: var(--c-text-muted); }
.rating-bar-count { text-align: end; color: var(--c-text-muted); min-width: 28px; }

.rating-bar-track {
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rating-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: oklch(75% 0.20 85);
  border-radius: inherit;
  width: var(--pct, 0%);
  transition: width 0.6s var(--ease-out);
}

/* ─── Thumbs up/down ─── */
.vote-btns {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.vote-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  background: transparent;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;

  &:hover { border-color: var(--c-text-muted); }
}

.vote-btn.up.voted   { background: var(--c-success-subtle); border-color: var(--c-success); color: var(--c-success); }
.vote-btn.down.voted { background: var(--c-danger-subtle);  border-color: var(--c-danger);  color: var(--c-danger); }

/* ─── NPS Score ─── */
.nps-selector {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.nps-btn {
  flex: 1;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.1s, border-color 0.1s, color 0.1s;

  &:hover { border-color: var(--c-accent); }
  &.selected { background: var(--c-accent); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
}

.nps-btn.low:hover  { border-color: var(--c-danger); }
.nps-btn.mid:hover  { border-color: var(--c-warning); }
.nps-btn.high:hover { border-color: var(--c-success); }
```

## 388. CSS ДЛЯ АНАЛИТИЧЕСКИХ ДАШБОРДОВ

```css
/* ─── Analytics Dashboard ─── */
.analytics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  grid-auto-rows: minmax(60px, auto);
  gap: var(--s-4);
  padding: var(--s-5);
}

/* Widget sizes */
.widget-1x1 { grid-column: span 3;  grid-row: span 2; }
.widget-2x1 { grid-column: span 6;  grid-row: span 2; }
.widget-3x1 { grid-column: span 9;  grid-row: span 2; }
.widget-full { grid-column: span 12; grid-row: span 3; }
.widget-half { grid-column: span 6;  grid-row: span 3; }
.widget-tall { grid-column: span 3;  grid-row: span 4; }

@media (width < 1024px) {
  .widget-1x1, .widget-2x1, .widget-3x1 { grid-column: span 6; }
  .widget-full, .widget-half { grid-column: span 12; }
}

@media (width < 640px) {
  .analytics-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  [class^="widget"] { grid-column: 1 !important; grid-row: span 1 !important; }
}

/* Base widget */
.widget {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-5);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.widget-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.widget-title {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.widget-menu {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, background 0.1s;
}

.widget:hover .widget-menu { opacity: 1; }
.widget-menu:hover { background: var(--c-muted); }

/* KPI Value */
.kpi-value-large {
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  line-height: 1;
}

.kpi-change {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  padding: 2px var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
}

.kpi-change.up   { background: var(--c-success-subtle); color: var(--c-success); }
.kpi-change.down { background: var(--c-danger-subtle);  color: var(--c-danger);  }
.kpi-change.flat { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text-muted); }

/* Mini chart in widget */
.widget-sparkline {
  margin-top: auto;
  height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
}

.spark-bar {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--c-accent-sub);
  border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  min-height: 4px;
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.1s;

  &:hover { background: var(--c-accent); }
  &:last-child { background: var(--c-accent); }
}

/* Donut chart */
.donut-widget {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-5);
}

.donut-chart {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 100px; height: 100px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(
    var(--c-accent)     0%         var(--s1, 45%),
    var(--c-success)    var(--s1, 45%) var(--s2, 70%),
    var(--c-warning)    var(--s2, 70%) var(--s3, 85%),
    var(--c-muted)      var(--s3, 85%) 100%
  );
  position: relative;
}

.donut-chart::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 18px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.donut-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.legend-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.legend-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.legend-label { flex: 1; color: var(--c-text-muted); }
.legend-value { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* Funnel widget */
.funnel-chart {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.funnel-step {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.funnel-bar {
  height: 32px;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  width: calc(var(--pct, 100%) );
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding-inline: var(--s-3);
  color: white;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  transition: width 0.6s var(--ease-out);
}

.funnel-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* Heatmap table widget */
.heatmap-widget table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.heatmap-widget td {
  padding: 4px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: white;
}
```

## 389. CSS ДЛЯ VIRTUAL SCROLL И INFINITE LIST

```css
/* ─── Virtual Scroll Container ─── */
.virtual-list {
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  position: relative;
  contain: strict;
  height: 600px; /* фиксированная высота обязательна */
}

/* Spacer — имитирует полную высоту списка */
.virtual-spacer {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 1px;
  height: var(--total-height, 10000px); /* задаётся через JS */
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Items viewport — только видимые */
.virtual-items {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  transform: translateY(var(--offset-y, 0px)); /* JS: смещение */
  will-change: transform;
}

.virtual-item {
  height: var(--item-height, 60px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: 0 var(--s-4);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  contain: layout paint;
}

/* ─── Infinite scroll trigger ─── */
.infinite-sentinel {
  height: 1px;
  margin-top: -1px;
  /* IntersectionObserver цепляется к этому элементу */
}

/* Loading skeleton at bottom */
.infinite-loading {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-4);
}

/* ─── Windowed Table ─── */
.windowed-table {
  position: relative;
  overflow: auto;
  height: 500px;
  contain: strict;
}

.windowed-table table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.windowed-table thead th {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  background: var(--c-surface);
}

.windowed-table .rows-wrapper {
  height: var(--total-rows-height, 5000px);
  position: relative;
}

.windowed-table .visible-rows {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; right: 0;
  top: var(--rows-offset, 0px);
  will-change: top;
}

/* ─── Pull to refresh ─── */
.pull-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pull-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% -100%;
  width: 40px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-lg);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--c-accent);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  transition: translate 0.3s ease, rotate 0.3s;
  z-index: 10;
}

.pull-wrapper.pulling .pull-indicator {
  translate: -50% var(--pull-offset, 0);
  rotate: calc(var(--pull-progress, 0) * 360deg);
}

.pull-wrapper.refreshing .pull-indicator {
  translate: -50% 60px;
  animation: spin 0.7s linear infinite;
}
```

## 390. CSS ДЛЯ СКЕЛЕТОНОВ — РАСШИРЕННАЯ СИСТЕМА

```css
/* ─── Skeleton System ─── */

/* Base skeleton animation */
@keyframes skeleton-wave {
  0%   { background-position: -200px 0; }
  100% { background-position: calc(200px + 100%) 0; }
}

.skeleton,
[data-skeleton] {
  background-color: var(--c-muted);
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--c-muted) 0px,
    oklch(from var(--c-muted) calc(l + 0.04) c h) 40px,
    var(--c-muted) 80px
  );
  background-size: 600px 100%;
  animation: skeleton-wave 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
}

/* ─── Semantic skeleton atoms ─── */
.sk-text {
  height: 1em;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-block-end: 0.4em;
}

.sk-text.short   { width: 40%; }
.sk-text.medium  { width: 70%; }
.sk-text.long    { width: 90%; }
.sk-text.full    { width: 100%; }

.sk-heading {
  height: 1.5em;
  width: 60%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-block-end: var(--s-3);
}

.sk-circle {
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sk-avatar-sm { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
.sk-avatar-md { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.sk-avatar-lg { width: 64px; height: 64px; }

.sk-image { border-radius: var(--r-xl); }
.sk-button { height: 36px; width: 120px; border-radius: var(--r-full); }

.sk-badge { height: 20px; width: 60px; border-radius: var(--r-full); }

/* ─── Skeleton Card Component ─── */
.sk-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.sk-card-image {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  margin: calc(-1 * var(--s-4)) calc(-1 * var(--s-4)) var(--s-3);
  width: calc(100% + var(--s-8));
  border-radius: 0;
}

.sk-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.sk-card-lines {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

/* ─── Skeleton Table ─── */
.sk-table {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.sk-table-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-2) 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
}

.sk-table-cell { height: 14px; border-radius: 3px; }
.sk-table-cell:nth-child(1) { flex: 2; }
.sk-table-cell:nth-child(2) { flex: 3; }
.sk-table-cell:nth-child(3) { flex: 1; }
.sk-table-cell:nth-child(4) { flex: 1; width: 60px; flex: none; }

/* ─── Skeleton dark mode ─── */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .skeleton,
  [data-skeleton] {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      var(--c-muted) 0px,
      oklch(from var(--c-muted) calc(l + 0.06) c h) 40px,
      var(--c-muted) 80px
    );
  }
}

/* ─── Transition: skeleton → content ─── */
.content-loaded .skeleton,
.content-loaded [data-skeleton] {
  animation: none;
  background: transparent;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.content-loaded .skeleton.fade-in {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* ─── Accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion ─── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .skeleton,
  [data-skeleton] {
    animation: none;
    background-image: none;
  }
}
```

## 391. CSS ДЛЯ АДАПТИВНЫХ ИЗОБРАЖЕНИЙ — ADVANCED

```css
/* ─── Art Direction через CSS (дополнение к <picture>) ─── */
.hero-img {
  --img-url: url('/images/hero-desktop.jpg');
  background: var(--img-url) center / cover no-repeat;
}

@media (width < 768px) {
  .hero-img {
    --img-url: url('/images/hero-mobile.jpg');
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; /* портретный кроп */
  }
}

/* ─── CSS image-set() полный паттерн ─── */
.banner {
  background-image: image-set(
    url('/images/banner.avif') type('image/avif') 1x,
    url('/images/banner@2x.avif') type('image/avif') 2x,
    url('/images/banner.webp') type('image/webp') 1x,
    url('/images/banner@2x.webp') type('image/webp') 2x,
    url('/images/banner.jpg') 1x,
    url('/images/banner@2x.jpg') 2x
  );
  background-size: cover;
}

/* ─── Aspect ratio containers ─── */
.img-16-9  { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.img-4-3   { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.img-1-1   { aspect-ratio: 1; }
.img-3-4   { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }
.img-9-16  { aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; }
.img-21-9  { aspect-ratio: 21 / 9; }
.img-2-35  { aspect-ratio: 2.35; } /* cinematic */

.img-container {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.img-container img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: var(--focus, center);
  display: block;
  transition: scale 0.4s ease, filter 0.4s;
}

/* Focus points by subject */
.img-face   { --focus: center 20%; }
.img-top    { --focus: center top; }
.img-bottom { --focus: center bottom; }
.img-left   { --focus: left center; }
.img-right  { --focus: right center; }

/* ─── Progressive loading ─── */
.img-progressive {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.img-blur-up {
  filter: blur(20px);
  scale: 1.05;
  transition: filter 0.6s ease, scale 0.6s ease;
}

.img-blur-up.loaded {
  filter: none;
  scale: 1;
}

/* ─── Lazy loading with IntersectionObserver styles ─── */
img[data-lazy] {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.5s;
}

img.lazy-loaded {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Native lazy loading */
img[loading="lazy"] {
  /* Браузер сам загрузит когда close to viewport */
}

/* ─── Responsive image grid ─── */
.photo-mosaic {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 4px;
}

.photo-mosaic img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

/* Pinterest / Masonry grid (columns fallback) */
.masonry-photos {
  column-count: 3;
  column-gap: 4px;
}

.masonry-photos img {
  width: 100%;
  display: block;
  break-inside: avoid;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
}

@supports (grid-template-rows: masonry) {
  .masonry-photos {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: masonry;
    column-count: initial;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .masonry-photos img { margin: 0; }
}

/* ─── Image with overlay caption ─── */
.captioned-img {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
}

.captioned-img figcaption {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  background: linear-gradient(to top, oklch(0% 0 0 / 80%), transparent);
  color: white;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  translate: 0 100%;
  transition: translate 0.3s;
}

.captioned-img:hover figcaption { translate: 0 0; }
```

## 392. CSS GRID SYSTEM — 12-КОЛОНОЧНАЯ СЕТКА

```css
/* ─── 12-Column Grid System ─── */
:root {
  --grid-columns: 12;
  --grid-gutter:  var(--s-4);
  --grid-margin:  clamp(var(--s-4), 5vw, var(--s-12));
}

.grid-container {
  max-width: 1280px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--grid-margin);
}

.grid-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--grid-columns), 1fr);
  gap: var(--grid-gutter);
}

/* Column spans */
.col-1  { grid-column: span 1; }
.col-2  { grid-column: span 2; }
.col-3  { grid-column: span 3; }
.col-4  { grid-column: span 4; }
.col-5  { grid-column: span 5; }
.col-6  { grid-column: span 6; }
.col-7  { grid-column: span 7; }
.col-8  { grid-column: span 8; }
.col-9  { grid-column: span 9; }
.col-10 { grid-column: span 10; }
.col-11 { grid-column: span 11; }
.col-12 { grid-column: span 12; }

/* Offsets */
.col-offset-1  { grid-column-start: 2; }
.col-offset-2  { grid-column-start: 3; }
.col-offset-3  { grid-column-start: 4; }
.col-offset-4  { grid-column-start: 5; }
.col-offset-6  { grid-column-start: 7; }

/* Responsive */
@media (width < 1024px) {
  .col-lg-6  { grid-column: span 6; }
  .col-lg-12 { grid-column: span 12; }
}

@media (width < 768px) {
  .col-md-6  { grid-column: span 6; }
  .col-md-12 { grid-column: span 12; }
}

@media (width < 480px) {
  .col-1, .col-2, .col-3, .col-4, .col-5,
  .col-6, .col-7, .col-8, .col-9 {
    grid-column: span 12; /* всё на 12 колонок на мобильных */
  }
  .col-sm-6  { grid-column: span 6; }
  .col-sm-12 { grid-column: span 12; }
}

/* ─── Nested grids ─── */
.col-6 .grid-row {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); /* вложенная сетка = половина */
}

/* ─── Auto responsive без breakpoints ─── */
.auto-grid-sm { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 240px), 1fr)); }
.auto-grid-md { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 320px), 1fr)); }
.auto-grid-lg { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 420px), 1fr)); }

/* ─── Stack variant ─── */
.grid-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--grid-gutter);
}

/* ─── Grid с named areas ─── */
.layout-sidebar-content {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-areas:
    "header header"
    "sidebar main"
    "footer footer";
  grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  gap: 0;
}

@media (width < 768px) {
  .layout-sidebar-content {
    grid-template-areas:
      "header"
      "main"
      "sidebar"
      "footer";
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
```

## 393. CSS UTILITY FRAMEWORK — ПОЛНАЯ РЕАЛИЗАЦИЯ

```css
/* ─── Complete Utility System ─── */
@layer utilities {

  /* ─── Display ─── */
  .d-block    { display: block; }
  .d-inline   { display: inline; }
  .d-flex     { display: flex; }
  .d-grid     { display: grid; }
  .d-none     { display: none; }
  .d-contents { display: contents; }

  /* ─── Flex ─── */
  .flex-row     { flex-direction: row; }
  .flex-col     { flex-direction: column; }
  .flex-wrap    { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .flex-nowrap  { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .flex-1       { flex: 1; }
  .flex-none    { flex: none; }
  .flex-auto    { flex: auto; }
  .flex-shrink-0 { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .flex-grow-0   { flex-grow: 0; }

  /* ─── Align ─── */
  .items-start    { align-items: flex-start; }
  .items-end      { align-items: flex-end; }
  .items-center   { align-items: center; }
  .items-stretch  { align-items: stretch; }
  .items-baseline { align-items: baseline; }
  .self-start     { align-self: flex-start; }
  .self-end       { align-self: flex-end; }
  .self-center    { align-self: center; }
  .self-stretch   { align-self: stretch; }

  /* ─── Justify ─── */
  .justify-start    { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .justify-end      { justify-content: flex-end; }
  .justify-center   { justify-content: center; }
  .justify-between  { justify-content: space-between; }
  .justify-around   { justify-content: space-around; }
  .justify-evenly   { justify-content: space-evenly; }
  .justify-self-end { justify-self: end; }

  /* ─── Place ─── */
  .place-center  { place-items: center; }
  .place-start   { place-items: start; }
  .place-end     { place-items: end; }

  /* ─── Gap ─── */
  .gap-0  { gap: 0; }
  .gap-1  { gap: var(--s-1); }
  .gap-2  { gap: var(--s-2); }
  .gap-3  { gap: var(--s-3); }
  .gap-4  { gap: var(--s-4); }
  .gap-5  { gap: var(--s-5); }
  .gap-6  { gap: var(--s-6); }
  .gap-8  { gap: var(--s-8); }
  .gap-x-2 { column-gap: var(--s-2); }
  .gap-x-4 { column-gap: var(--s-4); }
  .gap-y-2 { row-gap: var(--s-2); }
  .gap-y-4 { row-gap: var(--s-4); }

  /* ─── Spacing ─── */
  .p-0  { padding: 0; }
  .p-2  { padding: var(--s-2); }
  .p-4  { padding: var(--s-4); }
  .p-6  { padding: var(--s-6); }
  .p-8  { padding: var(--s-8); }
  .px-2 { padding-inline: var(--s-2); }
  .px-4 { padding-inline: var(--s-4); }
  .px-6 { padding-inline: var(--s-6); }
  .py-2 { padding-block: var(--s-2); }
  .py-4 { padding-block: var(--s-4); }
  .py-6 { padding-block: var(--s-6); }
  .m-0       { margin: 0; }
  .m-auto    { margin: auto; }
  .mx-auto   { margin-inline: auto; }
  .my-auto   { margin-block: auto; }
  .mt-0  { margin-top: 0; }
  .mt-4  { margin-top: var(--s-4); }
  .mt-8  { margin-top: var(--s-8); }
  .mb-4  { margin-bottom: var(--s-4); }
  .ml-auto { margin-inline-start: auto; }
  .mr-auto { margin-inline-end: auto; }

  /* ─── Sizing ─── */
  .w-full    { width: 100%; }
  .w-screen  { width: 100vw; }
  .w-auto    { width: auto; }
  .h-full    { height: 100%; }
  .h-screen  { height: 100dvh; }
  .h-auto    { height: auto; }
  .min-h-0   { min-height: 0; }
  .min-h-screen { min-height: 100dvh; }
  .max-w-sm  { max-width: 480px; }
  .max-w-md  { max-width: 640px; }
  .max-w-lg  { max-width: 800px; }
  .max-w-xl  { max-width: 1024px; }
  .max-w-2xl { max-width: 1280px; }
  .max-w-prose { max-width: 65ch; }

  /* ─── Position ─── */
  .relative  { position: relative; }
  .absolute  { position: absolute; }
  .fixed     { position: fixed; }
  .sticky    { position: sticky; }
  .static    { position: static; }
  .inset-0   { inset: 0; }
  .top-0     { top: 0; }
  .right-0   { right: 0; }
  .bottom-0  { bottom: 0; }
  .left-0    { left: 0; }

  /* ─── Overflow ─── */
  .overflow-hidden { overflow: hidden; }
  .overflow-auto   { overflow: auto; }
  .overflow-clip   { overflow: clip; }
  .overflow-scroll { overflow: scroll; }
  .overflow-x-auto { overflow-x: auto; }
  .overflow-y-auto { overflow-y: auto; }
  .truncate { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

  /* ─── Z-index ─── */
  .z-0     { z-index: 0; }
  .z-10    { z-index: 10; }
  .z-drop  { z-index: var(--z-drop); }
  .z-modal { z-index: var(--z-modal); }
  .z-top   { z-index: var(--z-top); }

  /* ─── Typography ─── */
  .text-xs    { font-size: var(--text-xs); }
  .text-sm    { font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .text-base  { font-size: var(--text-base); }
  .text-lg    { font-size: var(--text-lg); }
  .text-xl    { font-size: var(--text-xl); }
  .text-2xl   { font-size: var(--text-2xl); }
  .text-3xl   { font-size: var(--text-3xl); }
  .font-normal   { font-weight: var(--fw-normal); }
  .font-medium   { font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
  .font-semibold { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); }
  .font-bold     { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); }
  .font-black    { font-weight: 900; }
  .text-left     { text-align: left; }
  .text-center   { text-align: center; }
  .text-right    { text-align: right; }
  .text-start    { text-align: start; }
  .leading-tight    { line-height: var(--lh-tight); }
  .leading-normal   { line-height: var(--lh-normal); }
  .leading-relaxed  { line-height: var(--lh-relaxed); }
  .tracking-tight   { letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
  .tracking-wide    { letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  .tracking-wider   { letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
  .uppercase    { text-transform: uppercase; }
  .lowercase    { text-transform: lowercase; }
  .capitalize   { text-transform: capitalize; }
  .italic       { font-style: italic; }
  .no-underline { text-decoration: none; }
  .underline    { text-decoration: underline; }
  .line-through { text-decoration: line-through; }
  .text-wrap-balance { text-wrap: balance; }
  .text-wrap-pretty  { text-wrap: pretty; }
  .text-nowrap       { white-space: nowrap; }

  /* ─── Colors ─── */
  .text-default { color: var(--c-text); }
  .text-muted   { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
  .text-accent  { color: var(--c-accent); }
  .text-success { color: var(--c-success); }
  .text-danger  { color: var(--c-danger); }
  .text-warning { color: var(--c-warning); }
  .text-white   { color: white; }
  .text-inherit { color: inherit; }
  .bg-surface   { background: var(--c-surface); }
  .bg-muted     { background: var(--c-muted); }
  .bg-accent    { background: var(--c-accent); }
  .bg-success   { background: var(--c-success); }
  .bg-danger    { background: var(--c-danger); }
  .bg-transparent { background: transparent; }

  /* ─── Border ─── */
  .border        { border: 1px solid var(--c-border); }
  .border-0      { border: none; }
  .border-2      { border-width: 2px; }
  .border-t      { border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border); }
  .border-b      { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border); }
  .border-l      { border-left: 1px solid var(--c-border); }
  .border-r      { border-right: 1px solid var(--c-border); }
  .border-accent { border-color: var(--c-accent); }
  .rounded       { border-radius: var(--r-md); }
  .rounded-lg    { border-radius: var(--r-lg); }
  .rounded-xl    { border-radius: var(--r-xl); }
  .rounded-2xl   { border-radius: var(--r-2xl); }
  .rounded-full  { border-radius: var(--r-full); }
  .rounded-none  { border-radius: 0; }

  /* ─── Shadow ─── */
  .shadow-none { box-shadow: none; }
  .shadow-sm   { box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); }
  .shadow-md   { box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }
  .shadow-lg   { box-shadow: var(--sh-lg); }
  .shadow-xl   { box-shadow: var(--sh-xl); }

  /* ─── Opacity ─── */
  .opacity-0   { opacity: 0; }
  .opacity-50  { opacity: 0.5; }
  .opacity-75  { opacity: 0.75; }
  .opacity-100 { opacity: 1; }

  /* ─── Cursor ─── */
  .cursor-pointer     { cursor: pointer; }
  .cursor-not-allowed { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .cursor-grab        { cursor: grab; }
  .cursor-default     { cursor: default; }

  /* ─── Pointer events ─── */
  .pointer-events-none { pointer-events: none; }
  .pointer-events-auto { pointer-events: auto; }

  /* ─── User select ─── */
  .select-none { user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  .select-text { user-select: text; }
  .select-all  { user-select: all; }

  /* ─── Transform ─── */
  .rotate-90  { rotate: 90deg; }
  .rotate-180 { rotate: 180deg; }
  .rotate-270 { rotate: 270deg; }
  .flip-x     { scale: -1 1; }
  .flip-y     { scale: 1 -1; }

  /* ─── Transition ─── */
  .transition         { transition: all var(--dur-normal) ease; }
  .transition-colors  { transition: color var(--dur-normal) ease, background var(--dur-normal) ease, border-color var(--dur-normal) ease; }
  .transition-opacity { transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) ease; }
  .transition-shadow  { transition: box-shadow var(--dur-normal) ease; }
  .transition-none    { transition: none; }

  /* ─── Isolation ─── */
  .isolate    { isolation: isolate; }

  /* ─── Appearance ─── */
  .appearance-none { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; }

  /* ─── Accessibility ─── */
  .sr-only {
    position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0;
    margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
    white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
  }

  .not-sr-only {
    position: static; width: auto; height: auto; padding: 0;
    margin: 0; overflow: visible; clip: auto; white-space: normal;
  }

  /* ─── Print ─── */
  @media print {
    .print-hidden   { display: none !important; }
    .print-block    { display: block !important; }
    .print-break    { page-break-after: always; }
    .print-no-break { page-break-inside: avoid; }
  }

  /* ─── Responsive visibility ─── */
  @media (width < 640px)  { .hidden-mobile   { display: none !important; } }
  @media (width >= 640px) { .hidden-desktop  { display: none !important; } }
}
```

## 394. CSS БИБЛИОТЕКА АНИМАЦИЙ — ГОТОВЫЕ ЭФФЕКТЫ

```css
/* ─── Библиотека готовых анимаций ─── */

/* 1. Fade в разных направлениях */
@keyframes fade-in-up    { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0  20px; } }
@keyframes fade-in-down  { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 -20px; } }
@keyframes fade-in-left  { from { opacity: 0; translate: 20px 0;  } }
@keyframes fade-in-right { from { opacity: 0; translate:-20px 0;  } }
@keyframes fade-out-up   { to   { opacity: 0; translate: 0 -20px; } }
@keyframes fade-out-down { to   { opacity: 0; translate: 0  20px; } }

.anim-fade-in-up    { animation: fade-in-up    var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }
.anim-fade-in-down  { animation: fade-in-down  var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }
.anim-fade-in-left  { animation: fade-in-left  var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }
.anim-fade-in-right { animation: fade-in-right var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }

/* 2. Scale */
@keyframes zoom-in   { from { opacity: 0; scale: 0.85; } }
@keyframes zoom-out  { to   { opacity: 0; scale: 0.85; } }
@keyframes pop-in    { from { opacity: 0; scale: 0.5; } }
@keyframes zoom-in-90 { from { opacity: 0; scale: 0.9; } }

.anim-zoom-in   { animation: zoom-in   0.3s var(--ease-out)    both; }
.anim-zoom-out  { animation: zoom-out  0.2s ease-in            both; }
.anim-pop-in    { animation: pop-in    0.4s var(--ease-spring)  both; }

/* 3. Slide */
@keyframes slide-in-right  { from { translate:  100% 0; } }
@keyframes slide-in-left   { from { translate: -100% 0; } }
@keyframes slide-in-top    { from { translate: 0 -100%; } }
@keyframes slide-in-bottom { from { translate: 0  100%; } }
@keyframes slide-out-right { to   { translate:  100% 0; } }
@keyframes slide-out-left  { to   { translate: -100% 0; } }

.anim-slide-in-right  { animation: slide-in-right  0.3s var(--ease-out) both; }
.anim-slide-in-left   { animation: slide-in-left   0.3s var(--ease-out) both; }
.anim-slide-in-bottom { animation: slide-in-bottom 0.3s var(--ease-out) both; }

/* 4. Attention seekers */
@keyframes bounce {
  0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1); }
  50%       { translate: 0 -25%; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.8,0,1,1); }
}

@keyframes pulse-anim {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50%       { opacity: .5; }
}

@keyframes shake-anim {
  0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; }
  10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { translate: -6px 0; }
  20%, 40%, 60%, 80%      { translate:  6px 0; }
}

@keyframes wobble {
  0%, 100% { rotate: 0deg; }
  15%  { rotate: -5deg; }
  30%  { rotate:  5deg; }
  45%  { rotate: -3deg; }
  60%  { rotate:  3deg; }
  75%  { rotate: -1deg; }
  90%  { rotate:  1deg; }
}

@keyframes tada {
  0%  { scale: 1; rotate: 0deg; }
  10%, 20% { scale: .9; rotate: -3deg; }
  30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { scale: 1.1; rotate: 3deg; }
  40%, 60%, 80% { scale: 1.1; rotate: -3deg; }
  100% { scale: 1; rotate: 0deg; }
}

@keyframes rubber-band {
  0%   { scale: 1 1; }
  30%  { scale: 1.25 .75; }
  40%  { scale: .75 1.25; }
  50%  { scale: 1.15 .85; }
  65%  { scale: .95 1.05; }
  75%  { scale: 1.05 .95; }
  100% { scale: 1 1; }
}

.anim-bounce       { animation: bounce       1s infinite; }
.anim-pulse        { animation: pulse-anim   2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.anim-shake        { animation: shake-anim   0.6s ease both; }
.anim-wobble       { animation: wobble       1s both; }
.anim-tada         { animation: tada         1s both; }
.anim-rubber-band  { animation: rubber-band  1s var(--ease-out) both; }

/* 5. Спиннеры */
@keyframes spin { to { rotate: 360deg; } }
@keyframes spin-reverse { to { rotate: -360deg; } }
@keyframes ping { 75%, 100% { scale: 2; opacity: 0; } }

.anim-spin         { animation: spin         1s linear infinite; }
.anim-spin-slow    { animation: spin         3s linear infinite; }
.anim-spin-reverse { animation: spin-reverse 1s linear infinite; }
.anim-ping         { animation: ping         1s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) infinite; }

/* 6. Progress / Loading */
@keyframes progress-bar-stripes {
  from { background-position: 40px 0; }
  to   { background-position: 0 0; }
}

.anim-stripes {
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    oklch(100% 0 0 / 15%) 25%, transparent 25%,
    transparent 50%, oklch(100% 0 0 / 15%) 50%,
    oklch(100% 0 0 / 15%) 75%, transparent 75%, transparent
  );
  background-size: 40px 40px;
  animation: progress-bar-stripes 1s linear infinite;
}

/* 7. Delays (stagger helpers) */
.delay-75   { animation-delay:  75ms; }
.delay-100  { animation-delay: 100ms; }
.delay-150  { animation-delay: 150ms; }
.delay-200  { animation-delay: 200ms; }
.delay-300  { animation-delay: 300ms; }
.delay-500  { animation-delay: 500ms; }
.delay-700  { animation-delay: 700ms; }

/* 8. Duration modifiers */
.duration-75   { animation-duration:  75ms; }
.duration-100  { animation-duration: 100ms; }
.duration-150  { animation-duration: 150ms; }
.duration-200  { animation-duration: 200ms; }
.duration-300  { animation-duration: 300ms; }
.duration-500  { animation-duration: 500ms; }
.duration-700  { animation-duration: 700ms; }
.duration-1000 { animation-duration: 1000ms; }

/* 9. Fill mode helpers */
.fill-both     { animation-fill-mode: both; }
.fill-forwards { animation-fill-mode: forwards; }
.fill-none     { animation-fill-mode: none; }
```

## 395. CSS ПАТТЕРНЫ ЧИСЛОВЫХ ИНДИКАТОРОВ

```css
/* ─── Числовые бейджи ─── */
.num-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0 var(--s-1-5);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  background: var(--badge-bg, var(--c-accent));
  color: var(--badge-text, white);
}

.num-badge.sm { min-width: 16px; height: 16px; font-size: 10px; }
.num-badge.lg { min-width: 24px; height: 24px; font-size: var(--text-sm); }

/* Анимация при обновлении */
.num-badge.updated {
  animation: badge-pop 0.4s var(--ease-spring) both;
}

@keyframes badge-pop {
  0% { scale: 1; }
  40%{ scale: 1.4; }
  70%{ scale: 0.9; }
  100%{ scale: 1; }
}

/* 99+ обрезка */
.num-badge[data-count="99+"] {
  min-width: 28px;
}

/* ─── Прогресс кольца ─── */
.ring-progress {
  --size:   var(--ring-size, 80px);
  --stroke: var(--ring-stroke, 6px);
  --r:      calc((var(--size) / 2) - var(--stroke) / 2);
  --circ:   calc(2 * 3.14159265 * var(--r));
  --progress: var(--ring-progress, 0);

  width: var(--size);
  height: var(--size);
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.ring-progress svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  rotate: -90deg;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
}

.ring-track {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--c-muted);
  stroke-width: var(--stroke);
  r: var(--r);
  cx: calc(var(--size) / 2);
  cy: calc(var(--size) / 2);
}

.ring-fill {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--c-accent);
  stroke-width: var(--stroke);
  stroke-linecap: round;
  r: var(--r);
  cx: calc(var(--size) / 2);
  cy: calc(var(--size) / 2);
  stroke-dasharray: var(--circ);
  stroke-dashoffset: calc(var(--circ) * (1 - var(--progress)));
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.6s var(--ease-out);
}

.ring-label {
  font-size: calc(var(--size) * 0.22);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* ─── Числовые блоки (countdown segments) ─── */
.digit-block {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.digit-display {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  min-width: 2.5ch;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-sm);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Flip animation */
.digit-display::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--c-border);
}

/* ─── Скорость / Калибр-style meter ─── */
.gauge-meter {
  position: relative;
  width: 160px;
  height: 80px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.gauge-meter svg {
  width: 160px;
  height: 160px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0;
}

.gauge-bg {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--c-muted);
  stroke-width: 12;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 314; /* π * r (r=100) */
  stroke-dashoffset: 0;
}

.gauge-fill {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--c-accent);
  stroke-width: 12;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 314;
  stroke-dashoffset: calc(314 * (1 - var(--value, 0)));
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.8s var(--ease-out);
}

.gauge-needle {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 50%;
  width: 3px; height: 70px;
  background: var(--c-text);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transform-origin: bottom center;
  translate: -50% 0;
  rotate: calc(-90deg + var(--value, 0) * 180deg);
  transition: rotate 0.8s var(--ease-out);
}

.gauge-value {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
```

## 396. CSS ДЛЯ STEPPER КОМПОНЕНТОВ

```css
/* ─── Horizontal Stepper ─── */
.stepper {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0;
  counter-reset: step;
}

.step-item {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  position: relative;
  counter-increment: step;
}

/* Connecting line */
.step-item:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  left: calc(50% + 16px);
  right: calc(-50% + 16px);
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--line-color, var(--c-border));
  z-index: 0;
  transition: background 0.4s;
}

.step-item.done::after     { --line-color: var(--c-accent); }
.step-item.active::after   { --line-color: var(--c-accent); }

/* Step circle */
.step-circle {
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

.step-circle::before { content: counter(step); }

.step-item.done .step-circle {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
}

.step-item.done .step-circle::before { content: '✓'; }

.step-item.active .step-circle {
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--c-accent-sub);
}

.step-item.error .step-circle {
  border-color: var(--c-danger);
  background: var(--c-danger);
  color: white;
}

.step-item.error .step-circle::before { content: '✕'; }

/* Step label */
.step-label {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  max-width: 80px;
}

.step-item.done .step-label   { color: var(--c-text); }
.step-item.active .step-label { color: var(--c-accent); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); }

.step-sublabel {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 80px;
}

/* ─── Vertical Stepper ─── */
.stepper-vertical {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  counter-reset: vstep;
}

.vstep-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 0 var(--s-4);
  counter-increment: vstep;
}

.vstep-marker {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
}

.vstep-circle {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  z-index: 1;
}

.vstep-circle::before { content: counter(vstep); }
.vstep-item.done .vstep-circle   { background: var(--c-accent); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
.vstep-item.done .vstep-circle::before { content: '✓'; }
.vstep-item.active .vstep-circle { border-color: var(--c-accent); color: var(--c-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--c-accent-sub); }

.vstep-line {
  width: 2px;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 32px;
  background: var(--c-border);
  margin-block: 4px;
  transition: background 0.4s;
}

.vstep-item.done .vstep-line { background: var(--c-accent); }

.vstep-content {
  padding-bottom: var(--s-6);
  padding-top: 6px;
  min-height: 60px;
}

.vstep-title {
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  margin-bottom: var(--s-1);
}

.vstep-desc {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);
}

/* ─── Progress Step Bar (linear) ─── */
.progress-steps {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-step {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: 0;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}

.progress-step.done   { background: var(--c-accent); }
.progress-step.active {
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    var(--c-accent) var(--pct, 0%),
    var(--c-muted)  var(--pct, 0%)
  );
}

.progress-step:first-child { border-radius: var(--r-full) 0 0 var(--r-full); }
.progress-step:last-child  { border-radius: 0 var(--r-full) var(--r-full) 0; }
```

## 397. CSS ДЛЯ СЛОЖНЫХ TOOLTIP СИСТЕМЫ

```css
/* ─── Tooltip система с направлениями ─── */
[data-tooltip] {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

/* Стрелка */
[data-tooltip]::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--z-tooltip);
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.15s 0s, scale 0.15s;
  scale: 0.8;
}

/* Контент */
[data-tooltip]::after {
  content: attr(data-tooltip);
  position: absolute;
  z-index: var(--z-tooltip);
  background: var(--c-text);
  color: var(--c-bg);
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  white-space: nowrap;
  max-width: 280px;
  white-space: normal;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.15s 0s, scale 0.15s;
  scale: 0.9;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-lg);
}

/* Показ при hover и focus */
[data-tooltip]:hover::before,
[data-tooltip]:hover::after,
[data-tooltip]:focus-visible::before,
[data-tooltip]:focus-visible::after {
  opacity: 1;
  scale: 1;
  transition-delay: 0.3s;
}

/* ─── TOP (default) ─── */
[data-tooltip]:not([data-tip-pos])::before,
[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="top"]::before {
  bottom: calc(100% + 2px);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  border-top-color: var(--c-text);
  border-bottom: none;
}

[data-tooltip]:not([data-tip-pos])::after,
[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="top"]::after {
  bottom: calc(100% + 8px);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
}

/* ─── BOTTOM ─── */
[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="bottom"]::before {
  top: calc(100% + 2px);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  border-bottom-color: var(--c-text);
  border-top: none;
}

[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="bottom"]::after {
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
}

/* ─── LEFT ─── */
[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="left"]::before {
  right: calc(100% + 2px);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  border-left-color: var(--c-text);
  border-right: none;
}

[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="left"]::after {
  right: calc(100% + 8px);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  text-align: right;
}

/* ─── RIGHT ─── */
[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="right"]::before {
  left: calc(100% + 2px);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  border-right-color: var(--c-text);
  border-left: none;
}

[data-tooltip][data-tip-pos="right"]::after {
  left: calc(100% + 8px);
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  text-align: left;
}

/* ─── Цветные варианты ─── */
[data-tip-color="accent"]::before  { border-top-color: var(--c-accent) !important; }
[data-tip-color="accent"]::after   { background: var(--c-accent); }

[data-tip-color="success"]::before { border-top-color: var(--c-success) !important; }
[data-tip-color="success"]::after  { background: var(--c-success); }

[data-tip-color="danger"]::before  { border-top-color: var(--c-danger) !important; }
[data-tip-color="danger"]::after   { background: var(--c-danger); }

/* ─── Rich tooltip (через popover) ─── */
.rich-tooltip-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

.rich-tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + var(--s-2));
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: var(--s-4);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-xl);
  width: 280px;
  z-index: var(--z-tooltip);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  display: none;
  text-align: left;
}

.rich-tooltip-wrap:hover .rich-tooltip,
.rich-tooltip-wrap:focus-within .rich-tooltip {
  display: block;
  animation: fade-in-up 0.15s ease both;
}

.rich-tooltip::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -7px; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  border: 7px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--c-border);
  border-bottom: none;
}

.rich-tooltip::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -6px; left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--c-surface);
  border-bottom: none;
  z-index: 1;
}
```
