## 398. CSS ДЛЯ ICON СИСТЕМ

```css
/* ─── SVG Icon System ─── */

/* Базовый icon класс */
.icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
  color: currentColor;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

/* Размеры через font-size (масштабируемые) */
.icon-xs   { font-size: 12px; }
.icon-sm   { font-size: 16px; }
.icon-md   { font-size: 20px; }
.icon-base { font-size: 24px; }
.icon-lg   { font-size: 32px; }
.icon-xl   { font-size: 40px; }
.icon-2xl  { font-size: 48px; }
.icon-3xl  { font-size: 64px; }

/* Цвета */
.icon-muted   { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
.icon-accent  { color: var(--c-accent); }
.icon-success { color: var(--c-success); }
.icon-danger  { color: var(--c-danger); }
.icon-warning { color: var(--c-warning); }
.icon-inherit { color: inherit; }

/* Filled variant */
.icon-filled {
  fill: currentColor;
  stroke: none;
}

/* Двухтонная */
.icon-duotone {
  .primary   { opacity: 1; }
  .secondary { opacity: 0.3; }
}

/* ─── Icon Button ─── */
.icon-btn {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s, scale 0.1s;
  font-size: 20px;
  padding: 0;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-muted); color: var(--c-text); }
  &:active { scale: 0.9; }
  &:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

  /* Rounded */
  &.round { border-radius: 50%; }

  /* Primary */
  &.primary {
    background: var(--c-accent);
    color: white;
    &:hover { background: var(--c-accent-h); }
  }

  /* Ghost */
  &.ghost {
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    &:hover { border-color: var(--c-text-muted); }
  }
}

/* Размеры icon-btn */
.icon-btn.sm { width: 28px; height: 28px; font-size: 14px; }
.icon-btn.lg { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 24px; }
.icon-btn.xl { width: 52px; height: 52px; font-size: 28px; }

/* ─── Icon + Text ─── */
.icon-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* ─── Animated Icons ─── */

/* Spinner icon */
.icon-spin {
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

/* Pulsing dot */
.icon-ping {
  animation: ping 1s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite;
}

/* Hamburger → X */
.icon-menu {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 24px; height: 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.icon-menu-line {
  height: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  border-radius: 1px;
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.icon-menu.open .icon-menu-line:nth-child(1) {
  rotate: 45deg;
  translate: 0 8px;
}

.icon-menu.open .icon-menu-line:nth-child(2) {
  scale: 0 1;
  opacity: 0;
}

.icon-menu.open .icon-menu-line:nth-child(3) {
  rotate: -45deg;
  translate: 0 -8px;
}

/* Chevron toggle */
.icon-chevron {
  transition: rotate 0.2s ease;
}

[aria-expanded="true"] .icon-chevron { rotate: 180deg; }

/* Heart icon toggle */
.icon-heart {
  transition: scale 0.2s var(--ease-spring), fill 0.2s;
}

.icon-heart.liked {
  fill: var(--c-danger);
  color: var(--c-danger);
  animation: heart-pop 0.4s var(--ease-spring);
}

@keyframes heart-pop {
  0% { scale: 1; }
  30% { scale: 1.5; }
  60% { scale: 0.9; }
  100% { scale: 1; }
}

/* ─── CSS Icons (без SVG) ─── */

/* Стрелка */
.arrow-right {
  width: 0; height: 0;
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  border-left-color: currentColor;
  border-right: none;
}

/* Крест */
.x-icon {
  position: relative;
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
}

.x-icon::before,
.x-icon::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  border-radius: 1px;
  translate: 0 -50%;
}

.x-icon::before { rotate: 45deg; }
.x-icon::after  { rotate: -45deg; }

/* Чекмарк */
.check-icon {
  width: 16px; height: 12px;
  border-left: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
  rotate: -45deg;
  border-radius: 1px;
}
```

## 399. CSS ДЛЯ TICKET И BOOKING UI

```css
/* ─── Ticket Component ─── */
.ticket {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-lg);
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  max-width: 400px;
}

/* Zigzag perforated edge */
.ticket-perforation {
  display: flex;
  position: relative;
  height: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ticket-perforation::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: -12px;
  right: -12px;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  height: 24px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 12px 12px,
    var(--c-bg) 12px,
    transparent 12px
  );
  background-size: 24px 24px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}

/* Дырка слева */
.ticket::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -12px;
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  width: 24px; height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-bg);
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Дырка справа */
.ticket::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  right: -12px;
  top: 50%;
  translate: 0 -50%;
  width: 24px; height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-bg);
  z-index: 1;
}

.ticket-main {
  padding: var(--s-5) var(--s-6);
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ticket-visual {
  width: 80px; height: 80px;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.ticket-visual img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.ticket-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.ticket-title { font-weight: var(--fw-bold); font-size: var(--text-lg); }
.ticket-subtitle { color: var(--c-text-muted); font-size: var(--text-sm); }
.ticket-date { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); color: var(--c-accent); margin-top: var(--s-2); font-size: var(--text-sm); }

.ticket-divider {
  border: none;
  border-top: 2px dashed var(--c-border);
  margin: 0 var(--s-6);
  position: relative;
}

.ticket-stub {
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-6);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.ticket-qr {
  width: 64px; height: 64px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.ticket-barcode {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* Seat selector */
.seat-map {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--cols, 10), 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
  padding: var(--s-4);
  max-width: 500px;
}

.seat {
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  transition: background 0.1s, scale 0.1s;

  &:hover:not(.taken) { background: var(--c-accent-sub); scale: 1.15; }

  &.taken    { background: var(--c-muted); cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.4; }
  &.selected { background: var(--c-accent); border-color: var(--c-accent); }
  &.vip      { background: oklch(85% 0.12 85 / 30%); border-color: oklch(75% 0.20 85); }
}

/* Seat categories legend */
.seat-legend {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: var(--s-3);
}

.legend-seat {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
}

.legend-swatch {
  width: 14px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}
```

## 400. CSS ДЛЯ PAYMENT FLOWS

```css
/* ─── Payment Form ─── */
.payment-form {
  max-width: 480px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-5);
}

/* Card brand logos */
.payment-methods {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  align-items: center;
}

.payment-logo {
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  padding: 2px 6px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  opacity: 0.5;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.payment-logo.active { opacity: 1; }

/* Card number field with auto-spacing */
.card-num-field {
  position: relative;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
}

/* Security badge */
.payment-secure {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
}

.secure-icon { color: var(--c-success); }

/* Order Summary */
.order-summary {
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  padding: var(--s-5);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.order-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.order-item.total {
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  padding-top: var(--s-3);
  margin-top: var(--s-1);
}

.order-price {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.order-discount { color: var(--c-success); }
.order-tax      { color: var(--c-text-muted); }

/* Coupon input */
.coupon-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.coupon-input { flex: 1; font-family: var(--font-mono); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

.coupon-applied {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-success-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-success);
}

/* Pay button */
.pay-btn {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--s-4);
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  transition: background 0.15s, scale 0.1s;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;

  &:hover  { background: var(--c-accent-h); }
  &:active { scale: 0.99; }
  &:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: not-allowed; }
}

/* Processing animation */
.pay-btn.processing::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent, oklch(100% 0 0 / 20%), transparent
  );
  animation: shimmer 1.5s ease infinite;
  background-size: 200% 100%;
}

/* Trust badges */
.trust-badges {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.trust-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}
```

## 401. CSS ДЛЯ ВЫСОКОПЛОТНОГО UI (DENSE UI)

```css
/*
  Dense UI — максимум информации на экране.
  Используется в: трейдинговые терминалы, IDE, CRM, ERP.
*/

/* ─── Dense base ─── */
.dense {
  --gap:          var(--s-1);
  --padding:      var(--s-1-5);
  --font-size:    var(--text-xs);
  --line-height:  var(--lh-tight);
  --row-height:   24px;
  --input-height: 26px;

  font-size:   var(--font-size);
  line-height: var(--line-height);
}

.dense .btn {
  padding: var(--s-1) var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--font-size);
  height: var(--row-height);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
}

.dense .input {
  height: var(--input-height);
  padding: 0 var(--s-2);
  font-size: var(--font-size);
}

.dense .card { padding: var(--s-2); }
.dense .badge { padding: 1px var(--s-1-5); font-size: 10px; }

/* ─── Dense Table ─── */
.dense-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.dense-table th {
  height: 22px;
  padding: 0 var(--s-2);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-align: start;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.dense-table td {
  height: var(--row-height, 24px);
  padding: 0 var(--s-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.dense-table tr:hover td { background: var(--c-muted); }

/* Inline editing in dense table */
.dense-table td.editing {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: visible;
}

.dense-table td.editing input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-accent);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  padding: 0 var(--s-2);
  font: inherit;
  outline: none;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

/* ─── Dense Form ─── */
.dense-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-1) var(--s-3);
  align-items: center;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.dense-form label {
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: end;
  font-size: 11px;
}

/* ─── Dense Layout Tabs ─── */
.dense-tabs {
  display: flex;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  gap: 0;
}

.dense-tab {
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  margin-bottom: -1px;
  white-space: nowrap;

  &.active { color: var(--c-accent); border-bottom-color: var(--c-accent); }
  &:hover  { color: var(--c-text); }
}

/* ─── Trading Terminal UI ─── */
.trading-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 240px 240px;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  height: 100dvh;
  gap: 2px;
  background: oklch(8% 0 0);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: oklch(85% 0 0);
}

.trading-panel {
  background: oklch(12% 0 0);
  padding: var(--s-2);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.trading-label {
  color: oklch(50% 0 0);
  font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.price-up   { color: oklch(65% 0.20 145); }
.price-down { color: oklch(65% 0.20 25); }
.price-flat { color: oklch(65% 0 0); }

.orderbook-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: 1px var(--s-1);
  position: relative;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.orderbook-row::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.08;
  width: var(--depth, 0%);
}

.orderbook-bid .orderbook-row { color: oklch(65% 0.20 145); }
.orderbook-ask .orderbook-row { color: oklch(65% 0.20 25); }
```

## 402. CSS ДЛЯ КОДИРОВАНИЯ — EDITOR UI

```css
/* ─── Code Editor (VS Code style) ─── */
.code-editor-ui {
  display: grid;
  grid-template:
    "sidebar editor"    1fr
    "statusbar statusbar" 24px
    / 240px 1fr;
  height: 100dvh;
  background: oklch(14% 0 0);
  color: oklch(83% 0 0);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13px;
}

/* Activity bar */
.activity-bar {
  width: 48px;
  background: oklch(18% 0 0);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding-block: var(--s-2);
  gap: var(--s-2);
  border-right: 1px solid oklch(22% 0 0);
}

.activity-icon {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: oklch(55% 0 0);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  transition: color 0.1s;
  position: relative;

  &:hover  { color: oklch(85% 0 0); }
  &.active {
    color: oklch(90% 0 0);
    &::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px;
      width: 2px;
      background: oklch(70% 0.20 260);
      border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
    }
  }
}

/* Sidebar (file explorer) */
.editor-sidebar {
  grid-area: sidebar;
  background: oklch(16% 0 0);
  border-right: 1px solid oklch(22% 0 0);
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.sidebar-header {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: oklch(55% 0 0);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.file-tree-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1-5);
  padding: 2px var(--s-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: oklch(75% 0 0);
  user-select: none;
  padding-left: calc(var(--depth, 0) * 16px + var(--s-2));

  &:hover  { background: oklch(22% 0 0); color: oklch(90% 0 0); }
  &.active { background: oklch(25% 0.05 260); color: oklch(90% 0 0); }
}

.file-tree-icon {
  font-size: 14px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 16px;
}

/* Tab bar */
.editor-tabs {
  display: flex;
  background: oklch(18% 0 0);
  border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(22% 0 0);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.editor-tab {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-4);
  border-right: 1px solid oklch(22% 0 0);
  cursor: pointer;
  color: oklch(55% 0 0);
  font-size: 13px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-width: 120px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
  border-top: 1px solid transparent;

  &:hover  { color: oklch(85% 0 0); background: oklch(20% 0 0); }
  &.active {
    color: oklch(90% 0 0);
    background: oklch(14% 0 0);
    border-top-color: oklch(70% 0.20 260);
  }
}

.tab-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.1s;
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

  &:hover { background: oklch(30% 0 0); }
}

.editor-tab:hover .tab-close,
.editor-tab.active .tab-close { opacity: 1; }

/* Editor area */
.editor-area {
  grid-area: editor;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: oklch(14% 0 0);
}

.code-area {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.line-numbers {
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4) var(--s-3) var(--s-3);
  text-align: right;
  color: oklch(35% 0 0);
  user-select: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: 48px;
}

.code-content {
  flex: 1;
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-6) var(--s-3) var(--s-3);
  white-space: pre;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: oklch(83% 0 0);
  tab-size: 2;
}

/* Current line highlight */
.code-line.current { background: oklch(20% 0 0); }

/* Syntax */
.tok-keyword    { color: oklch(70% 0.22 280); }
.tok-string     { color: oklch(70% 0.15 130); }
.tok-number     { color: oklch(72% 0.18 40); }
.tok-comment    { color: oklch(48% 0 0); font-style: italic; }
.tok-function   { color: oklch(72% 0.16 60); }
.tok-class      { color: oklch(72% 0.18 185); }
.tok-variable   { color: oklch(78% 0.10 220); }
.tok-operator   { color: oklch(75% 0.10 30); }
.tok-property   { color: oklch(68% 0.14 260); }
.tok-punctuation{ color: oklch(65% 0 0); }

/* Status bar */
.status-bar {
  grid-area: statusbar;
  background: oklch(from var(--c-accent) 45% 0.20 h);
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding-inline: var(--s-3);
  gap: var(--s-4);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.status-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-1);
  opacity: 0.9;
  cursor: pointer;
  &:hover { opacity: 1; }
}

.status-separator { opacity: 0.3; }
.status-right { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: var(--s-4); }
```

## 403. CSS ДЛЯ ТЕСТИРОВАНИЯ ПРОИЗВОДИТЕЛЬНОСТИ

```css
/* ─── CSS Performance Test Utilities ─── */

/* Намеренно медленный CSS для тестирования */
/* .perf-test-slow { filter: blur(0); } ← вызывает repaint */

/* Маркеры для профайлера */
.perf-mark {
  /* border: 0px solid transparent; */ /* minimal reflow trigger для тестов */
}

/* ─── Layout Debug Overlay ─── */
.debug-layout {
  --dbg-opacity: 0.3;
}

.debug-layout * { outline: 1px solid oklch(65% 0.22 260 / var(--dbg-opacity)); }
.debug-layout [class*="flex"], .debug-layout [style*="flex"] {
  outline-color: oklch(65% 0.22 145 / var(--dbg-opacity));
}
.debug-layout [class*="grid"], .debug-layout [style*="grid"] {
  outline-color: oklch(65% 0.22 25 / var(--dbg-opacity));
}
.debug-layout [style*="position: absolute"],
.debug-layout [style*="position: fixed"] {
  outline-color: oklch(65% 0.22 300 / var(--dbg-opacity));
  outline-style: dashed;
}

/* Highlight elements that trigger reflow */
.debug-reflow-triggers {
  &:hover, &:focus {
    outline: 3px solid red !important;
  }
}

/* ─── A/B Testing utility classes ─── */
[data-variant="A"] .variant-B,
[data-variant="B"] .variant-A { display: none; }

/* ─── Feature flags visual debugging ─── */
[data-feature-flag="disabled"] {
  position: relative;
  &::after {
    content: 'FLAG OFF';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; right: 0;
    background: var(--c-danger);
    color: white;
    font-size: 8px;
    padding: 1px 4px;
    border-radius: 0 0 0 4px;
    z-index: 9999;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-weight: bold;
    opacity: 0;
  }
  &:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
}

/* ─── CSS Container для benchmarking ─── */
.bench-container {
  contain: strict;
  width: 300px;
  height: 200px;
  /* Изменения внутри не вызывают reflow снаружи */
}

/* ─── Motion tracker ─── */
@keyframes motion-debug {
  from { outline-color: red; }
  to   { outline-color: blue; }
}

.debug-animate * {
  animation: motion-debug 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

/* ─── CSS Stats tracking через custom properties ─── */
.track-specificity {
  /* @stylelint-disable-next-line selector-max-compound-selectors */
  /* Намеренно высокая специфичность для тестирования */
  --specificity-test: 1;
}
```

## 404. CSS ДЛЯ ЧАТА С ПОДДЕРЖКОЙ — CUSTOMER SERVICE

```css
/* ─── Customer Support Chat Widget ─── */
.chat-widget-btn {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: calc(var(--s-6) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0));
  right: var(--s-6);
  width: 56px; height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.4);
  z-index: var(--z-fixed);
  transition: scale 0.2s var(--ease-spring), box-shadow 0.2s;

  &:hover {
    scale: 1.1;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 24px oklch(from var(--c-accent) l c h / 0.5);
  }

  &:active { scale: 0.95; }
}

/* Unread indicator */
.chat-widget-btn .unread-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px; right: 2px;
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  background: var(--c-danger);
  border: 2px solid white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: bold;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}

/* Chat popup window */
.chat-popup {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0));
  right: var(--s-6);
  width: 360px;
  max-height: min(600px, 80dvh);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-2xl);
  box-shadow: var(--sh-2xl);
  z-index: var(--z-modal);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;

  /* Анимация открытия */
  transform-origin: bottom right;
  animation: chat-open 0.3s var(--ease-out) both;
}

@keyframes chat-open {
  from { opacity: 0; scale: 0.8; translate: 20px 20px; }
}

/* Chat header */
.chat-popup-header {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
  padding: var(--s-4) var(--s-5);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.support-avatar {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 30%);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 20%);
}

.support-info .name { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); font-size: var(--text-sm); }
.support-info .status { font-size: var(--text-xs); opacity: 0.8; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-1); }
.online-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(75% 0.20 145); }

/* ─── Canned responses ─── */
.canned-responses {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.canned-btn {
  padding: var(--s-1-5) var(--s-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.1s;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--c-text);

  &:hover { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; border-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

/* ─── File attachment preview ─── */
.attachment-preview {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  max-width: 240px;
}

.attach-thumb {
  width: 36px; height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  object-fit: cover;
  background: var(--c-border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.attach-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.attach-name { font-weight: var(--fw-medium); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.attach-size { color: var(--c-text-muted); }

.attach-remove {
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  &:hover { background: var(--c-danger-subtle); color: var(--c-danger); }
}
```

## 405. CSS ДЛЯ SURVEY И ОПРОСНИКОВ

```css
/* ─── Survey Form ─── */
.survey {
  max-width: 640px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: var(--s-8) var(--s-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-8);
}

/* Progress */
.survey-progress {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.survey-progress-bar {
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--c-muted);
  border-radius: var(--r-full);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.survey-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: inherit;
  width: var(--progress, 0%);
  transition: width 0.4s var(--ease-out);
}

/* Question */
.survey-question {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  animation: fade-in-up 0.3s ease both;
}

.question-num {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--c-accent);
}

.question-text {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.question-hint {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* Option cards (single/multi choice) */
.survey-options {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-2);
}

.survey-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-3);
  padding: var(--s-3) var(--s-4);
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  user-select: none;

  &:hover    { border-color: var(--c-accent); background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
  &.selected { border-color: var(--c-accent); background: var(--c-accent-sub); }

  & input { accent-color: var(--c-accent); }
}

.option-letter {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.survey-option.selected .option-letter {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  color: white;
}

/* Scale question (1-10) */
.scale-question {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--s-3);
}

.scale-buttons {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--s-1);
}

.scale-btn {
  flex: 1;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.1s;

  &:hover    { border-color: var(--c-accent); background: var(--c-accent-sub); }
  &.selected { background: var(--c-accent); border-color: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
}

.scale-labels {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* Matrix question */
.matrix-question {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.matrix-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.matrix-table th {
  padding: var(--s-2) var(--s-3);
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.matrix-table th:first-child { text-align: start; }

.matrix-table td {
  padding: var(--s-2-5) var(--s-3);
  text-align: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-muted);

  &:first-child { text-align: start; font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
}

.matrix-table tr:hover td { background: var(--c-muted); }

/* Emoji reaction survey */
.emoji-survey {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
  padding: var(--s-4) 0;
}

.emoji-option {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--s-2);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: var(--s-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  transition: background 0.1s, scale 0.1s;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
}

.emoji-option:hover { background: var(--c-muted); scale: 1.1; }
.emoji-option.selected { background: var(--c-accent-sub); border-color: var(--c-accent); }

.emoji-face { font-size: 2.5rem; }
.emoji-label { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--c-text-muted); }
```

## 406. CSS ДЛЯ LANDING PAGE ГЕРОЕВ — 10 ВАРИАНТОВ

```css
/* ─── Hero 1: Gradient центрированный ─── */
.hero-gradient-center {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-6);
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% 0%,
    oklch(65% 0.22 260 / 20%), transparent),
    var(--c-bg);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ─── Hero 2: Split с изображением ─── */
.hero-split-image {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  min-height: 100dvh;
}

.hero-split-image .text-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-12);
}

.hero-split-image .img-col {
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.hero-split-image .img-col img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
}

/* ─── Hero 3: Dark с neon акцентом ─── */
.hero-dark-neon {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  background: oklch(8% 0 0);
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-20) var(--s-6);
  position: relative;
}

.hero-dark-neon .headline {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 0.95;
}

.hero-dark-neon .accent-word {
  color: oklch(75% 0.30 180);
  text-shadow:
    0 0 20px oklch(75% 0.30 180 / 50%),
    0 0 60px oklch(75% 0.30 180 / 20%);
}

/* ─── Hero 4: Minimal с большим типом ─── */
.hero-type-minimal {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  padding: var(--s-20);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

.hero-type-minimal .headline {
  font-size: clamp(4rem, 12vw, 9rem);
  font-weight: var(--fw-black);
  letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  line-height: 0.9;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* ─── Hero 5: Карточка в центре ─── */
.hero-card-center {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: var(--s-8);
  background: var(--c-muted);
}

.hero-card-center .card {
  max-width: 600px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--s-12);
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-2xl);
}

/* ─── Hero 6: Полноэкранное видео ─── */
.hero-video-bg {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
}

.hero-video-bg video {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  z-index: 0;
}

.hero-video-bg .overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 60%);
  z-index: 1;
}

.hero-video-bg .content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  color: white;
  padding: var(--s-8);
}

/* ─── Hero 7: Bento grid ─── */
.hero-bento {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
  gap: var(--s-4);
  padding: var(--s-6);
}

.hero-bento .main-text { grid-column: 1 / 3; }
.hero-bento .main-cta  { grid-column: 3; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; }
.hero-bento .feature-cards { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--s-4); }

/* ─── Hero 8: Fullscreen с scroll ─── */
.hero-sticky-scroll {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 100dvh;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ─── Hero 9: Asymmetric ─── */
.hero-asymmetric {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
  gap: 0;
}

.hero-asymmetric .main { background: var(--c-accent); color: white; }
.hero-asymmetric .side { background: var(--c-surface); }

/* ─── Hero 10: Animated background ─── */
.hero-animated-bg {
  min-height: 100dvh;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.animated-shape {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(80px);
  animation: float-shape 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.shape-1 { width: 500px; height: 500px; background: oklch(65% 0.22 260 / 30%); top: -100px; left: -100px; animation-delay: 0s; }
.shape-2 { width: 400px; height: 400px; background: oklch(65% 0.22 300 / 25%); top: 20%; right: -50px; animation-delay: -3s; }
.shape-3 { width: 350px; height: 350px; background: oklch(65% 0.22 200 / 20%); bottom: -50px; left: 30%; animation-delay: -6s; }

@keyframes float-shape {
  0%   { translate: 0 0; scale: 1; }
  100% { translate: 40px -40px; scale: 1.1; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .animated-shape { animation: none; }
}

/* Responsive для hero паттернов */
@media (width < 768px) {
  .hero-split-image,
  .hero-bento,
  .hero-asymmetric { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

  .hero-type-minimal { padding: var(--s-8); }
  .hero-card-center .card { padding: var(--s-8); }
}
```
